jobs.title: Consultant Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Consultant Acquisition Specialist for a global company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 75% onsite in Stockholm.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the end-to-end consultant engagement lifecycle for assigned Staff Augmentation Consultant demand, ensuring accurate administration, traceability, and compliant handling in relevant systems.

Review and validate intake submissions, clarify scope and requirements, and challenge unclear demand to support sound sourcing and engagement decisions.

Lead competitive sourcing through the preferred supplier network by default and manage exceptions through documented rationale and escalation where needed.

Select and brief suppliers, assess submissions, build shortlists, and provide structured feedback to improve quality, relevance, and speed over time.

Support consultant selection and fee alignment, while final candidate choice remains with the hiring manager, and contribute to cost discipline through rate guidance and benchmarking where applicable.

Manage extensions, early terminations, offboarding, and compliance-related escalations, and partner with Procurement and adjacent teams to reinforce the preferred supplier model and support continuous improvement.

﻿

REQUIREMENTS

Experience and background: Relevant experience in consultant acquisition, contingent workforce coordination, procurement-supported hiring, or a similar role involving supplier interaction, stakeholder management, and end-to-end process coordination in a complex environment.

Education or certification: Relevant academic background or equivalent professional experience in HR, business, procurement, operations, or a related field.

Skills and competencies: Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to clarify demand, challenge unclear requirements, and support sound decisions without formal authority. Strong commercial awareness, structured judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to balance cost, quality, speed, and compliance are important.

Tools, systems, or methods: Experience working in an evolving environment with shifting priorities, and strong familiarity with Vendor Management Systems (VMS), KPI follow-up, and reporting to support decision-making and continuous improvement.

Other expectations: Able to work effectively across different business functions and hiring stakeholders while maintaining delivery quality and supporting continuous improvement.

﻿ This role requires fluency in English and Swedish.

This is a full-time consultant position in Stockholm through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 75% onsite in Stockholm.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

Profil recherché
Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire.

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Frontend web app & native apps
- Language : TypeScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Librairies: Tanstack Query, React Router, Lingui

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Radix ui, Storybook

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

Frontend Web
- Language : Django templating language & TypeScript

- Librairies: Htmx, Alpinejs

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Alpinejs, Storybook

Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Bases de données : MySQL et MongoDB

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)
Tu as envie de travailler sur de multiples projets où les mises en production de tes travaux sont rapides ?
Tu veux intégrer une Greentech travaillant sur des produits à la pointe en Europe ?
Tu veux utiliser la data pour proposer des services

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:

Base de Données

Infrastructure & Déploiement

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

 - You will explore ambiguous areas and conduct analysis to identify opportunities for the Growth org, helping shape the strategy and roadmap.

 - You'll partner closely with product, engineering, and marketing leaders at every step of the development process, driving forward data science and analytics work.

 - You'll work with your teams to determine north star and operational metrics, and build the foundational datasets and dashboards to monitor progress and make key decisions.

 - You'll influence the broader company by communicating your findings and driving change in our product and business. (Insights are useful. Impact is even better!)

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by business results.

 - You have expertise in SQL and at least one scripting language (ideally Python or R).

 - You are comfortable transforming raw data to build your own data sets if the measure you need doesn't exist yet.

 - You have a bias for using the right tools to get a job done with maximum efficiency. You have experience making tradeoffs between speed and accuracy.

 - You have worked at a fast-growing start-up.

RASKAAN KALUSTON ASENTAJAA KESKI-SUOMEEN

jobs.title: Bid Manager
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

You will work in an international environment with employees at our regional Bid Management offices in Houston, Orlando, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Beijing, Duisburg as well as with sales representatives all over the world.

You will have colleagues both within Gas Services and Compression business and learn new things in each sales project. The job includes a certain amount of business travel, where the number of travel days varies depending on the sales situation and personal wishes. The work offers a technical and commercial breadth that few others can offer and is an excellent gateway for future career paths in project management or sales.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    You will do technical bids based on our MGT fleet
    You will have an active role in both technical and commercial negotiations with our customers
    You will present our products and technical solutions for our customers
    You will hand over the project to delivery organization for execution after contract closure

What You Bring

    You are an engineer eager to work with both commercial and technical solutions
    You have experience from engineering, commissioning or similar that have given a deeper technical understanding of our products
    You have been working with complex projects preferable in a role with customer interaction
    You are open-minded and enjoy driving challenging missions forward and take them to the finish line
    English in speech and writing is a prerequisite, if you also have knowledge of other languages, it is meritorious

About the Team

The oil and gas team are today 15 persons with both mechanical and electrical background. The group works very independently and has a supportive atmosphere where everyone helps each other to perform their best.

Colleagues in other groups, within Bid Management, work with IPG, FEED and extended scope.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 302464 not later than 2026-09-15

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

Haemme nyt tiimiimmeKotisiivoojiapalvelemaan asiakkaitamme Lohjan alueella. Tehtävänäsi on toimia ikäihmisen tai vammaisen siivoojana ja huolehtia kodinhoitajana hänen kotinsa siisteydestä luotettavasti ja vastuullisesti.

Kotisiivoojan työ sopii monenlaisissa elämäntilanteissa oleville, sillä voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, mitä työvuoroja otat vastaan. Voit olla eläkeläinen, opiskelija, alan ammattilainen tai jotain siltä väliltä. Saat meiltä kattavan perehdytyksen sekä koulutuksen tehtävään ja esihenkilösi on aina tavoitettavissa.

Tarjoamme:

* Kiireettömän, vastuullisen ja merkityksellisen työn

* Lämminhenkisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

* Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuoroihin

* Hyvän perehdytyksen

* Kilpailukykyinen palkka 15€ /h

Odotamme sinulta:

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Hyviä sosiaalisia taitoja

* Positiivista asennetta

Eduksi katsomme siivousalan koulutuksen.

Edellytämme lisäksi työnhakijalta pitkäaikaista sitoutumista tehtävään, sillä meillä käy asiakkaan luona aina sama työntekijä, jolloin myös itse työ on tuttua ja turvallista niin asiakkaalle kuin työntekijällekin. Samalla turvaamme palvelun laadun ja jatkuvuuden.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan osa-aikaisena.Työ sopii hyvin myös reippaalle eläkeläiselle, joka haluaa lisää mielekästä ja vastuullista tekemistä omaan arkeensa.

Tarkistamme valittujen rikosrekisteriotteet Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvontalain mukaisesti.

Palkkaus määräytyy tehtävän vaativuuden mukaan ja on 15 €/h, jonka lisäksi maksetaan yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. Olemme vastuullinen työnantaja ja meillä kaikki työntekijät ovat työsuhteessa. Kerrytät työssäsi normaalisti eläkettä ja olet luonnollisesti oikeutettu myös lomakorvauksiin.

jobs.title: Begeleider – Ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking
jobs.description:
Jouw werkplek

Op jouw nieuwe werkplek wonen cliënten met een ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking (EVMB+), soms met bijkomende gedragsproblematiek. Samen met jouw team bied je hen een veilige, betrouwbare omgeving waarin zij zich op hun eigen manier kunnen ontwikkelen. Op je werkplek word je ondersteund door een zorgcoördinator en gedragsdeskundige, die je helpen bij het begeleiden van cliënten met moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag.

Elke dag zorg je voor een zinvolle invulling, thuis of bij dagbesteding dichtbij. Met een persoonlijk en groepsgericht dagprogramma bied je structuur en veiligheid, zodat bewoners zich écht thuis voelen. Of het nu gaat om een wandeling, een activiteit in de woonkamer of samen rustig zitten – jullie doen het samen, in een omgeving vol vertrouwen.

Jouw rol en aanpak Je werkt volgens de Triple C-visie, waarbij onvoorwaardelijke begeleiding en het samen ondernemen van betekenisvolle activiteiten centraal staan. Met een luisterend oor en oog voor non-verbale signalen stem jij af op de behoefte van de cliënten. Je bent alert op subtiele veranderingen, zodat je op tijd kunt inspelen op wat iemand fysiek of emotioneel nodig heeft.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ondersteuning bieden bij persoonlijke verzorging en indien nodig verpleegkundige handelingen.
  • Begeleiden bij dagelijkse activiteiten, zoals zwemmen, wandelen en fietsen afgestemd op de individuele behoeften van de cliënt.
  • Je moet kunnen observeren, rapporteren en helder kunnen communiceren.
  • Je werkt vanuit verbinding samen met collega’s en het sociale netwerk van de cliënten.

Wat heb je nodig?

  • Je hebt ervaring of affiniteit met de zorg voor cliënten met een ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking
  • Je bent geduldig, empathisch en kunt goed afstemmen op de behoeften van de cliënt
  • Je werkt onvoorwaardelijk en kunt voorbij probleemgedrag kijken om tot de kern te komen

jobs.title: Ajoneuvoasentaja/Korjaamopäällikkö
jobs.description:
AJONEUVOASENTAJA / KORJAAMOPÄÄLLIKKÖ

**ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy – Hyvinkää**

ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy on uusi, kasvava ja kehittyvä autokorjaamo Hyvinkäällä. Haemme nyt joukkoomme **kokenutta ajoneuvoasentajaa / korjaamopäällikköä**, joka haluaa ottaa vastuuta korjaamon päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja olla mukana rakentamassa yrityksestä juuri sellaisen kuin siitä parhaimmillaan voi tulla.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain asentaja muiden joukossa. Etsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa **ottaa vastuuta, kehittää toimintaa ja vaikuttaa siihen, mihin suuntaan yritys tulevaisuudessa menee.**

TEHTÄVÄ

Korjaamopäällikkönä vastaat korjaamon päivittäisestä toiminnasta yhdessä toimitusjohtajan kanssa. Työhön kuuluu sekä käytännön korjaamotyötä että korjaamon johtamiseen ja kehittämiseen liittyviä tehtäviä.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- Ajoneuvojen vianhaku, diagnostiikka ja korjaaminen

- Huolto- ja korjaustöiden suunnittelu ja työnjohto

- Asiakaspalvelu ja asiakkaiden kanssa asiointi

- Tarjouslaskenta ja töiden hinnoittelu

- Työmääräysten tekeminen ja töiden aikataulutus

- Varaosien ja tarvikkeiden tilaaminen

- Korjaamon päivittäisen toiminnan organisointi

- Työn laadun ja tehokkuuden seuranta

- Reklamaatioiden ja haastavien asiakastilanteiden hoitaminen

- Korjaamon toimintatapojen, palveluiden ja työskentelyn kehittäminen

- Työkalujen, laitteiden ja muiden hankintojen suunnittelu

- Muut korjaamopäällikön tehtävät


Tehtävässä pääset siis tekemään monipuolisesti **sekä käsillä että päällä**.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on vähintään noin **2–5 vuoden kokemus ajoneuvoalalta** ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti.

Sinulta odotamme erityisesti:

- Vahvaa ajoneuvojen teknistä osaamista

- Kykyä itsenäiseen vianhakuun ja vaativampienkin korjausten tekemiseen

- Oma-aloitteisuutta

- Vastuuntuntoa

- Hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- Kykyä organisoida ja priorisoida työtehtäviä

- Halua kehittää sekä itseäsi että työpaikkaa

- Yrittäjähenkistä ja rakentavaa asennetta


**VAG-osaaminen katsotaan erityiseksi eduksi**, mutta haemme ennen kaikkea hyvää ja monipuolista ajoneuvoalan ammattilaista.

B-ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön.

MITÄ ME TARJOAMME?

ModHaus on uusi yritys, joten tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan asioihin tavalla, joka ei välttämättä ole mahdollista suuremmissa ja valmiiksi organisoiduissa korjaamoissa.

**Sinun ei tarvitse vain sopeutua valmiisiin toimintatapoihin – pääset rakentamaan niitä kanssamme.**

Kuuntelemme työntekijöiden kehitysehdotuksia ja haluamme antaa korjaamopäällikölle mahdollisimman hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittää toimintaa. Keskustelemme asioista yhdessä toimitusjohtajan kanssa, mutta tehtävässä on **suhteellisen vapaat kädet viedä korjaamoa haluttuun suuntaan**.

Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan esimerkiksi:

- Korjaamon toimintatapoihin

- Työkaluihin ja laitteisiin

- Palveluiden kehittämiseen

- Varaosahankintoihin ja yhteistyökumppaneihin

- Hinnoitteluun ja työn tehokkuuteen

- Asiakaspalveluun

- Korjaamon tulevaisuuden suuntaan


Ja mikä tärkeintä, **onnistuessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa yrityksen mukana.**

MAHDOLLISUUS OSAKKUUTEEN

Tehtävässä on **mahdollisuus myöhemmässä vaiheessa yrityksen osakkuuteen**.

Etsimme siis henkilöä, joka ei välttämättä halua olla vain työntekijä, vaan jolla on halua ja kiinnostusta olla rakentamassa ModHausista pitkäjänteisesti menestyvää yritystä.

TYÖSUHDE

- **Tehtävä:** Ajoneuvoasentaja / Korjaamopäällikkö

- **Työsuhde:** Vakituinen

- **Työaika:** 37,5 h / viikko

- **Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian

- **Palkkaus:** Sopimuksen ja kokemuksen mukaan

- **Työpaikka:** Hyvinkää


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos kuulostaa siltä, että tämä voisi olla sinun paikkasi, **lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille itsestäsi, työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaisena näet hyvän ja toimivan autokorjaamon.**

Hakemuksen voit lähettää sähköpostitse osoitteeseen:

**sami@modhaus.fi**

Voit hakea myös suoraan ilmoituksen hakulinkin kautta.

**ModHaus Autokorjaamo Oy**_Rakennetaan yhdessä korjaamo, jossa haluaisimme itsekin asioida._

jobs.title: Enhetschef Centrala elevhälsan
jobs.description:
Vill du leda och utveckla elevhälsoarbetet i Härnösands kommun?

Vi söker en enhetschef till Centrala elevhälsan – en strategisk och verksamhetsnära ledarroll för dig som vill skapa goda förutsättningar för barns och elevers trygghet, hälsa och lärande.

Centrala elevhälsan samlar flera professioner med ett gemensamt uppdrag: att stärka förskolornas och skolornas förebyggande och hälsofrämjande arbete och ge barn och elever rätt stöd i rätt tid. Som enhetschef leder du ett tvärprofessionellt team med skolsköterskor, psykologer, kuratorer och specialpedagoger. Skolläkarkompetens finns att tillgå utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Du får en central roll i Skolförvaltningens utvecklingsarbete och arbetar nära förvaltningsledning och rektorer. Rollen kombinerar strategiskt ansvar med närvaro i verksamheten – där du leder, utvecklar och skapar förutsättningar för dina medarbetare och för en sammanhållen barn- och elevhälsa.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka på riktigt, i en organisation som värdesätter samarbete, initiativkraft och ett lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt.

Arbetsuppgifter

I den här rollen leder och utvecklar du Centrala elevhälsan med målet att skapa en sammanhållen, tillgänglig barn- och elevhälsa av hög kvalitet som stärker förskolornas och skolornas förutsättningar att möta alla barn och elevers behov. Du arbetar på både strategisk och operativ nivå och har en viktig roll i att utveckla det förebyggande och hälsofrämjande elevhälsoarbetet på huvudmannanivå.

Du arbetar nära rektorer och förvaltningsledning och bidrar till att barn- och elevhälsans kompetenser blir en integrerad del av förskolornas och skolornas arbete med inkluderande lärmiljöer, trygghet, hälsa och lärande.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    Ansvara för personalledning, arbetsmiljö och verksamhetsutveckling inom Centrala elevhälsan.
    Leda och utveckla medarbetare med olika professionell kompetens och skapa förutsättningar för ett välfungerande tvärprofessionellt arbete.
    Driva och följa upp det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet på huvudmannanivå, inklusive analys, dokumentation och rapportering.
    Samordna barn- och elevhälsans stöd till förskolorna och skolorna och säkerställa en god samverkan med rektorer och andra funktioner.
    Leda och utveckla det förebyggande och hälsofrämjande barn- och elevhälsoarbetet med fokus på likvärdiga förutsättningar för alla barn elever.
    Samverka med externa aktörer, exempelvis hälso- och sjukvård, socialtjänst och BUP, samt andra relevanta samarbetspartners.
    Bidra till strategiska utvecklingsprojekt inom utbildningsområdet och omsätta fattade beslut till konkret verksamhetsutveckling.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att leda människor och verksamhet i en komplex organisation och som vill bidra till att utveckla förskolans och skolans elevhälsoarbete. Du är van att ta ansvar, skapa struktur och driva frågor framåt tillsammans med andra. Du har förmåga att se helheten, väga samman olika perspektiv och fatta välgrundade beslut även när uppdraget är komplext.

Vi söker dig som har:

    Relevant akademisk examen, exempelvis inom pedagogik, beteendevetenskap, socialt arbete eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant.
    Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet från skola, elevhälsa eller annan verksamhet med koppling till barn och ungas hälsa, utveckling och lärande.
    Minst tre års erfarenhet av chefs- eller ledaruppdrag med personal- och verksamhetsansvar.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en komplex organisation med flera samverkande aktörer.
    Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.
    God digital kompetens och vana att använda verksamhetssystem som en del av det dagliga arbetet.

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av att leda tvärprofessionella verksamheter eller arbetsgrupper, gärna inom elevhälsa eller utbildningsområdet.
    Erfarenhet av förändringsledning och att driva verksamhetsutveckling inom skola eller kommunal verksamhet.
    Erfarenhet av arbete i en politiskt styrd organisation.
    God erfarenhet av samverkan med exempelvis hälso- och sjukvård, socialtjänst, BUP eller andra externa aktörer.
    Erfarenhet av systematiskt kvalitetsarbete med analys, uppföljning och utveckling.
    Kunskap om relevanta lagar såsom skollagen, hälso och sjukvårdslagen samt styrdokument, kopplat till elevhälsa och skolans uppdrag

Som person har du:

    Struktur – du planerar, prioriterar och skapar tydlighet även när uppdraget är komplext och många frågor behöver hanteras samtidigt.
    God samarbetsförmåga – du bygger förtroendefulla relationer, lyssnar in olika perspektiv och bidrar till konstruktiv dialog och lösningar.
    Helhetssyn – du ser elevhälsans uppdrag i relation till förskolans och skolans övergripande mål och kan väga det egna verksamhetsområdets behov mot hela organisationens bästa.
    Gott omdöme – du kan väga samman komplex information, olika perspektiv och hänsynstaganden och fatta välgrundade beslut.

Stor vikt kommer läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

jobs.title: Kauneudenhoitoalan ammattilainen.
jobs.description:
Kauneusalan ammattilainen haussa – tule osaksi ihanaa tiimiämme!

**Yksi paikka vapautuu 1.11.2026** nykyisen kauneudenhoitoalan ammattilaisemme jäädessä äitiyslomalle.

Kaunis ja viihtyisä salonkimme sijaitsee **Keravan keskustassa**, ja nyt etsimme joukkoomme **ammattitaitoista, itsenäistä ja suomenkielistä kauneusalan ammattilaista**.

**Valmista asiakaskuntaa on jo osittain seuraaville palveluille:** pedikyyrit, manikyyrit, sokeroinnit, vahaukset, geelilakkaukset, geelikynnet, kasvohoidot

Salongissamme on **yhteisessä tilassa oma työpiste kynsipalveluille** sekä **erillinen hoitohuone muille kauneudenhoitopalveluille**.

Työskentely on mahdollista **prosenttipohjaisesti tai vuokratuoliperiaatteella** – sovitaan sinulle sopivasta vaihtoehdosta.

Etsimme ennen kaikkea **luotettavaa, asiakaslähtöistä ja ammattitaitoista tekijää**, joka työskentelee itsenäisesti ja haluaa liittyä osaksi meidän **lämminhenkistä, iloista ja ystävällistä työyhteisöämme**.

jobs.title: R&D Project manager
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Project Manager for R&D at Siemens Energy, you will play an important role in driving the energy transition forward each day!

Imagine a dynamic environment where you lead development projects for our gas turbines. Each project varies in size and complexity, ensuring that no two days are the same.

Your typical day could include leading project meetings with your team to assess progress, planning the project, presenting technical solutions in formal reviews, or discussing requirements with suppliers and customers.

And since we operate in a global arena you will interact with team members, suppliers, and customers from all corners of the world.

You will be leading teams to deliver high-quality technical solutions that shape the future of energy.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Lead and coordinate R&D projects to meet technical requirements, timeframes, and budget constraints effectively.
    Build and inspire high-performing project teams capable of delivering excellent technical solutions.
    Ensure seamless coordination and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders for smooth project execution.
    Develop and maintain good relationships with customers, partners, and suppliers to guarantee project success.

What You Bring

    Experience in leading complex R&D projects in technical environments. Project management certifications are meritorious
    Excellent leadership abilities, enabling you to guide cross-functional teams effectively
    Technical knowledge about gas turbines, especially in the electrical area, is meritorious
    Excellent collaborative skills to promote cooperation and teamwork
    Strong personal drive and a solution-oriented approach to overcoming challenges
    Proficiency in both Swedish and English

About the Team

Our team consists of 16 project managers, who have diverse backgrounds and extensive expertise, including deep knowledge of gas turbine development. With proficiency in both predictive and agile project management approaches, and certifications to back our skills, our team ensures excellence in every project.

We have an open and collaborative environment where help is always close at hand. By regularly discussing project challenges and sharing out experience, we support each other to overcome obstacles and impediments. Our focus is always on finding solutions, and together, we turn every challenge into an opportunity. Plus, we make sure to have fun while working hard!

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic Remote Diagnostic Center’s Intelligent Statistics & Analytics team (RDC ISA), where expertise is vital in ensuring business continuity. Dive into fleet operational data from Medium, Small, and Aeroderivative Gas Turbines to uncover performance trends that enhance reliability engineering. Lead technical investigations to identify root causes of failures and collaborate with engineering teams to implement effective mitigation strategies. Contributions will directly translate statistical findings into actionable product and service improvements, making a significant impact on operational oversight and strategic objectives.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    You make sure that collection, aggregation and analysis of fleet operational data is made in industry qualitative manner to monitor performance across Medium, Small, and Aeroderivative Gas Turbines.
    Calculate and report on key reliability indicators, including availability, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and Forced Outage Hours (FOH).
    Identify and present ‘Top Offenders’ to product managers and engineering stakeholders, highlighting primary causes of downtime.
    Initiate and lead technical investigations to determine root causes of outages and collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop mitigation plans.
    Ensure the quality and integrity of operational statistics while improving processes for data collection and utilization.

What You Bring

    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, or a related technical field.
    Significant experience as an Application, Commissioning, Design, or Reliability Engineer, preferably with Siemens Energy gas turbines.
    Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to manage and interpret large, complex technical datasets.
    Proficiency in SQL and a solid understanding of gas turbine systems and operational statistics analysis.
    Excellent collaboration, influencing skills, and technical communication abilities to engage stakeholders effectively.

The RDC for Gas Services consists of two departments, one for the daily operations to deliver active monitoring with notifications & monitoring reports (RDC AIM) and one for the development and sustaining of analytics & Operation Statistics for the distributed fleet. The team RDC ISA are today eight engineers with various backgrounds in programming, data science & mechanical engineering. RDC ISA supports the RDC AIM team with improving & developing new analytics to detect symptoms of failures to prevent forced outages and collects, aggregates, calculates and report statistics for AGT, MGT and SGT fleet. jobs.title: Behandlingspedagog till SiS ungdomshem Råby
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.

SiS ungdomshem Råby tar emot både flickor och pojkar. Vi har både slutna och öppna platser för sluten ungdomsvård samt behandlingsplatser för LVU-placerade ungdomar.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du vara med när SiS expanderar och skapa den livsviktiga förändringen för utsatta människor? Då är jobbet som behandlingspedagog hos SiS en meningsfull utmaning. Som behandlingspedagog arbetar du i team tillsammans med behandlingsassistenter och behandlingssamordnare och tillsammans ansvarar ni för att de ungdomar och klienter som bor hos oss får den trygghet, vård och behandling som de behöver. Vi möter ofta människor i kris, vilket innebär att du jobbar med kvalificerat omvårdnads-och motivationsarbete och med att vara ett stöd i vardagen. Med stöd av dina kunskaper inom vård- och behandlingsarbete bidrar du aktivt till att behandlingsplaner fullföljs. Dokumentation är en viktig del av ditt arbete, och bidrar bland annat till rättssäkerhet, planering och uppföljning av vår verksamhet. Du bidrar till att säkerheten upprätthålls enligt våra rutiner och du medverkar till att vardagen flyter på med skolgång, städning, matlagning med mera. Kontaktmannaskap är också en av dina arbetsuppgifter. I arbetet kan det även ingå att vara handledare åt nya medarbetare och praktikanter. Det här är ett arbete för dig som ser en positiv utmaning i att få arbeta med utsatta människor i en svår livssituation. Jobbet är många gånger krävande men också stimulerande, glädjefyllt och omväxlande.

Vår vision är att vara en plats för förändring och det genomsyrar vårt bemötande, vårt engagemang och vårt förhållningssätt.

För att möta målgruppens behov ser vi gärna manliga sökanden.

Arbetstiden är enligt schema dag - kväll och varannan helg.

Som ny medarbetare kommer du att genomgå SiS grundutbildning på 10 veckor. I utbildningen varvas teori med en handledd introduktion och utbildningen rustar dig för behandlarrollen i SiS verksamhet.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i ditt arbete har du en grundmurad positiv människosyn. Du är motiverad att hjälpa människor i en utsatt livssituation och du delar SiS värdegrund, att vara en plats för förändring. Vidare har du en god förmåga att skapa engagemang och delaktighet hos våra ungdomar. Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har lätt för att skapa relation med ungdomar likväl som med övriga i personalgruppen. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan behålla ditt lugn även i pressade situationer. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra och du kan hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Du ska också ha:

    Minst en examen från 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning vid folkhögskola eller yrkeshögskola (KY/YH) med inriktning mot socialt/pedagogiskt behandlingsarbete eller utbildning från högskola som vi bedömer likvärdig
    B- körkort
    God svenska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av arbete med människor i utsatta livssituationer, t.ex. arbete inom psykiatri eller inom LSS omsorg
    Erfarenhet från klientnära befattningar på Kriminalvården, t.ex. Kriminalvårdare
    Erfarenhet av arbete med vår målgrupp (t.ex. missbruksvård, ungdomsvård, unga flickor etc.)

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Sista ansökningsdag 2026-09-20.

SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer to a Global Company in Västerås
jobs.description:
About the company

Our client is a global industrial company that creates products, solutions, and services within areas including automation and electrification. The group operates in more than 100 countries with over 100,000 employees worldwide. They develop technology that makes industries more efficient, more reliable, and that keeps the world running, every day.

At our client, you'll be part of an organisation where technical expertise, responsibility, and long-term thinking are at the centre. We're looking for people who take ownership and constantly strive to get better at what they do, in an environment with strong support, experienced colleagues, and the opportunity to develop over time.

About the role

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will work in the division working with high voltage rotating machines, ranging from motors and generators to synchronous condensers, for some of the world's most demanding industrial environments. The service organisation in Västerås is responsible for supporting the globally installed base of these machines.

In this role you'll be part of the technical support team and work closely with local service units, external customers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring a high level of service and professionalism in every interaction.

Key responsibilities

    

Provide technical support to local service units, external customers, and internal teams

    

Handle warranty cases for factory products, including technical investigations and root cause analysis

    

Manage and follow up on support cases in a shared case management system

    

Ensure cases and projects are handled in a structured, professional, and high-quality manner

    

Deliver clear and effective communication from both a technical and customer perspective

    

Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team

Who we're looking for

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems and communicating clearly with customers. To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

    

A vocational education in automation or other related field, or a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, automation, energy systems, or a similar field

    

Experience and knowledge of PLC programming, ideally function block programming

    

Knowledge of testing and troubleshooting

    

Good communication skills in English, as the role involves contact with customers and colleagues globally. Swedish is an advantage but not required

It's an advantage if you have

    

Previous experience in a technical role, preferably within testing and troubleshooting of electrical machines and control cabinets

    

Experience with systems such as Salesforce and SAP

Personal qualities

You're customer-focused and collaborative, with a strong service mindset, and thrive on handling demanding customer dialogues in a global environment. You're a natural team player who also takes initiative, with strong prioritisation skills and a level head when several cases are running in parallel. You're curious, solution-oriented, and genuinely interested in contributing to the team's continuous improvement work.

Practical information

Start: To be discussed Location: Västerås Scope: Full-time Employment: You will initially be employed by A-hub as a consultant, with the ambition of moving to direct employment with our client after 12 months

Does this sound like an interesting opportunity? Don't hesitate to send in your application today – the selection process is ongoing!

A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy (https://www.a-hub.se/integritetspolicy).

jobs.title: Barcelona Varmkundsförsäljning
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till varmkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Social Sciences
jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a four-year full-time position as PhD Research Fellow at the Centre for Research on Equality in Education (CREATE), University of Oslo, Norway. 

CREATE is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway with the objective of generating novel knowledge about how to reduce social inequality. The interdisciplinary center integrates researchers with substantive expertise from education, psychology, sociology, economics, and genetics, and methodological expertise from educational measurement, psychometrics, econometrics, statistics, and biostatistics. The PhD fellowship is affiliated with CREATE’s research strand 1 «Identifying the barriers to equality in education», aiming to disentangle the causal mechanisms that hinder equality and to understand for whom, how, and why these mechanisms operate over time and across the life course.

The PhD fellow will be part of the interdisciplinary Convergence Environment “NeuroPathways: A Multidisciplinary Convergence Approach to Understanding and Supporting Neurodevelopmental Variability”, funded through the University of Oslo. The project integrates economics, sociology, genetics, psychology, pharmacology, and educational sciences to advance our understanding of neurodevelopmental variability and improve evidence-based and inclusive support strategies across the life course. 

We are looking for a motivated and engaged PhD fellow with strong potential for high-quality research. The position includes 25% career-promoting work, which may consist of teaching, dissemination, and contributions to NeuroPathways interdisciplinary and convergence activities. The career-promoting work will depend on the candidate’s qualifications and CREATE's needs. 


More about the position

Convergence Environments are interdisciplinary research groups that aim to solve grand challenges related to health and the environment. They are funded by UiO's interdisciplinary strategic area UiO:Life Science . 

Neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD and autism are being diagnosed more than ever — but why, and with what consequences? NeuroPathways is an interdisciplinary Convergence Environment that brings together sociology, economics, psychology, genetics, pharmacology, education, and clinical research to address questions about neurodevelopmental variability that cannot be answered within disciplinary silos. The NeuroPathways research environment bridges biomedical and social science perspectives to examine how genetic predispositions and environments — from clinics to classrooms — jointly shape developmental outcomes, using Norway’s exceptional registry and cohort data to study why diagnoses are rising, who receives assessment and support, which interventions work best for whom, and how support systems can become more equitable and inclusive.

This PhD position has an education and society-oriented focus. The PhD fellow will work with large-scale register and cohort data to investigate how social structures interact with individual and family-level risk factors to influence life-course trajectories. Within this framework, the successful candidate will focus on key areas such as examining fairness in support across educational institutions and groups, describing life-course trajectories by taking an intersectional approach incorporating genetics, gender, and socioeconomic background, and identifying specific school characteristics that foster inclusive environments and mitigate the effects of genetic predispositions. This work will integrate descriptive and causal approaches to map outcomes across education, the labor market, and health from childhood through early adulthood.

The PhD fellow will be embedded in the interdisciplinary NeuroPathways Convergence Environment. Professor Astrid Sandsør or Associate Professor Nicolai Borgen, both at the Center for Research on Equality in Education – CREATE, will serve as primary supervisors with overall responsibility for the PhD project. Professor Hedvig Nordeng (Department of Pharmacy) will serve as secondary supervisor. 

The PhD fellow will collaborate closely with researchers across the NeuroPathways Team, including experts in psychology and genetics, education and inequality, pharmacoepidemiology, and clinical psychology. The PhD fellow will work with advanced quantitative methods, contribute to joint publications within NeuroPathways, and participate in interdisciplinary seminars and training activities.

The PhD fellow will take part in the approved PhD program at the Faculty of Educational Sciences and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the PhD fellowship is to qualify the candidate for a research career within or beyond academia. To support a strategic and well-structured PhD trajectory, the PhD fellow will be required to develop a career and competence development plan in dialogue with the supervisory team early in the appointment period. The successful candidate will receive close supervision and is encouraged to develop a strong international research profile through collaboration, conference participation, and research stays abroad.

For more information, please see our web site. 


Qualification requirements

Applicants must satisfy the requirements for admission to the faculty´s PhD program. This normally includes:

  • Applicants must hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in Economics, Sociology, Education, Psychology or other relevant fields
  • A Master’s degree (120 ECTS) with a minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent. The master’s degree must include a thesis of at least 30 ECTS, with a minimum grade B
  • A Bachelor’s degree with a minimum grade C (ECTS grading scale)
  • For 5-year studies, the average grade must be C or better for the first three years, and B or better for the last two years (ECTS grading scale). The Master thesis must have been graded with a minimum grade B
  • Advanced quantitative research skills
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

In the assessment of applications, emphasis will be placed on:

  • The quality of the project description and the research topic’s relevance to NeuroPathways
  • Familiarity with quasi-experimental methods for causal inference 
  • Familiarity with administrative register data or other types of big data
  • Familiarity with R, Stata, Python, or other relevant computing languages
  • Documented research experience or educational background related to neurodevelopmental conditions 

Personal skills 

Personal suitability and motivation for the position will be emphasized and assessed based on the following qualities:

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary research teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to give and receive constructive scientific feedback
  • Structured, reliable, and results-oriented working style
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission
  • Opportunity to work with world-class research data
  • Inclusion in the NeuroPathways Convergence Environment’s professional and social activities and broad network of early career researchers (doctoral and postdoctoral fellows)
  • Dedicated colleagues in a friendly and international research environment, recognized as a Centre of Excellence
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Salary NOK 550 800 - 594 000 per annum depending on qualifications in a position as PhD Research Fellow, (position code 1017). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • Attractive welfare benefits and a generous pension agreement, in addition to Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities

How to apply and what to include in your application

The application must include:

  • Application letter (max. 2 pages) describing motivation for applying, previous research experience, research interests, and how your qualifications match the position
  • A project description, including progress plan (5-7 pages). Please see our guidelines. 
    • Choose a topic relevant to NeuroPathways and motivate your interest
    • Identify a potential research question and suggest a methodological approach and study design to pursue this question
    • Include a tentative progress plan for the PhD, including coursework you would benefit from
  • CV with a complete overview of education, work experience, and other qualifying activities 
  • Publication list, including Master’s thesis and any other academic work (including preprints, talks, or posters)
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only). Foreign applicants must attach an explanation of their grading system
  • Documentation of English proficiency (for information on required documentation, see information on this webpage)
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number)

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. 

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language). 

When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the project description and the applicant’s academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. Applicants may be called in for an interview. 


Formal regulations

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Research Fellowships, Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The appointment may be shortened/given a more limited scope within the framework of the applicable guidelines on account of any previous employment in academic positions.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.

jobs.title: Klar til å forme fremtidens løsninger for maritim sikkerhet?
jobs.description:
Hvert år seiler flere tusen fartøy verden over med sikkerhetsutstyr fra Martin Bruusgaard om bord. I over 60 år har vi bygget oss en posisjon som et av de ledende selskapene innen deteksjonsløsninger for maritim bransje, og i dag er vår løsning for bærbar gassdeteksjon installert på over 3 000 fartøy verden over.

Vi er kjent for The Bruusgaard System (TBS), som overvåker status på kundenes fartøy, sørger for at riktig instrumentering er om bord, og bidrar til at kalibrering og vedlikehold gjennomføres i tråd med gjeldende krav og regelverk. I tillegg leverer vi andre løsninger, utviklet slik at mannskapet i størst mulig grad selv skal kunne utføre vedlikehold om bord. Det reduserer kostnader, øker sikkerheten og forenkler logistikken for kundene våre.

Nå er vi inne i en positiv utvikling, og skal styrke det tekniske teamet vårt videre inn i neste vekstfase. Vi utvider tilbudet vårt fra bærbar til også å omfatte faste gassdeteksjonssystemer, og satser samtidig videre på digitalisering – med kundeportalen myBruusgaard som en sentral del av samhandlingen med kundene, og kunstig intelligens som et arbeidsverktøy vi forventer skal bli stadig viktigere i årene fremover.

Som en del av det tekniske teamet vårt får du varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver i et miljø med høyt tempo og stor aktivitet. Du jobber på tvers av organisasjonen, bygger bred forståelse for produktene, kundene og driften vår, og er med på å forme veien videre i en bedrift i vekst.

Litt om arbeidsoppgaver

Som en del av vårt tekniske team vil du få varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver i et miljø med høyt tempo og stor aktivitet. Du vil jobbe på tvers av organisasjonen og utvikle en bred forståelse av våre produkter, løsninger, kunder og operasjoner. En vanlig arbeidshverdag vil bestå av:

  • Teknisk support til kunder, og kollegaer
  • Feilsøking, teknisk problemløsning og enkel service på vårt serviceverksted ved kontoret i Sandvika
  • Tilpasse og videreutvikle teknisk dokumentasjon
  • Bidra til videreutvikling av myBruusgaard og andre digitale arbeidsverktøy
  • Bruke AI-verktøy aktivt og hensiktsmessig i det daglige arbeidet
  • Delta i tekniske prosjekter og utviklingsarbeid
Våre tanker om din utdannelse og erfaring

Vi tror denne stillingen passer deg med teknisk bakgrunn og god kommersiell forståelse, en nyutdannet ingeniør eller en kandidat med relevant praktisk erfaring. Du bør trives med kundekontakt, ha god teknisk og digital forståelse og være interessert i å sette deg inn i nye produkter og løsninger.

Relevant erfaring kan være fra kundeservice, teknisk support, feilsøking, faste deteksjonssystemer eller andre tekniske og datarelaterte løsninger. Erfaring fra maritim industri eller olje- og gassindustrien vil være en fordel.

  • God teknisk forståelse og problemløsningsevne
  • Interesse for digitale løsninger og bruk av AI-verktøy
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk og engelsk
Personlige egenskaper vi tror passer med oss:

For å lykkes i rollen må du like å arbeide effektivt, klare å prioritere og trives med flere parallelle oppgaver. Stillingen gir gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og bred erfaring gjennom arbeid med teknisk support, gassdeteksjon, digitale løsninger, utvikling og prosjektarbeid. Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Liker å engasjere deg slik at oppgaver løses til rett tid, det å være pålitelig er naturlig
  • Er teknisk nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert
  • Er grundig og systematisk, liker å skape gode rutiner og arbeidsvaner
  • Er samarbeidsorientert og lærevillig, gjerne med god kapasitet
  • Er ansvarsfull og opptatt av kvalitet
Dette får du her:
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø preget av entusiasme, faglig tyngde og lekenhet
  • Kollegaer som liker jobben og faget sitt
  • Grundig opplæring og støtte underveis
  • Høyt tempo, stor aktivitet og varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Mulighet til å utvikle bred teknisk kompetanse
  • Mulighet til å arbeide med nye digitale løsninger og AI i praksis
  • Sosiale aktiviteter, både faste og spontane – noen ganger reiser vi på tur
  • Store og lyse kontorlokaler med nærhet til offentlig transport
  • God lønn, pensjon- og bonusordning

Vi er opptatt av å finne den rette kandidaten og oppfordrer deg til å søke dersom du mener dette kan være jobben for deg – selv om du ikke oppfyller alle kvalifikasjonene.

Søknader vil bli vurdert fortløpende!

Hvem er vi?

Martin Bruusgaard har hovedkontor i Sandvika, og er en del av Addtech-konsernet. Vi er stolte av den lange historien vår i maritim bransje, og jobber hver dag for at kundene våre skal ha trygge og pålitelige løsninger om bord – enten det gjelder gassdeteksjon, kalibrering eller andre sikkerhetskritiske systemer.

jobs.title: Myyntineuvottelija, Oulu
jobs.description:
Haluatko tehdä tuloksellista myyntityötä, kehittää myyntitaitojasi ja vaikuttaa ansioihisi oman onnistumisesi kautta? Etsimme nyt myyntineuvottelijaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 1.9.2026-31.12.2026.

Tässä tehtävässä työskentelet osana myyntitiimiä ja vastaat aktiivisesta ulospäin suuntautuvasta puhelinmyynnistä olemassa oleville asiakkaille. Keskusteluissa kartoitat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja tarjoat heille arkea helpottavia tietoliikenne- ja tietoturvapalveluita sekä muita asiakkaalle soveltuvia lisäpalveluratkaisuja. Työ voi sisältää myös muita myynnillisiä kampanjoita ja projekteja.

Jos saat energiaa onnistuneista asiakaskohtaamisista, tavoitteiden ylittämisestä ja oman tuloksesi kehittämisestä, viihdyt tässä työssä erinomaisesti!

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos

- Nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja tavoitteellisesta työstä
- Uskallat tarttua puhelimeen ja käydä aktiivisia myyntikeskusteluja
- Motivoidut tuloksista ja haluat vaikuttaa omiin ansioihisi
- Olet positiivinen, oma-aloitteinen ja sinnikäs
- Opit nopeasti uusia tuotteita ja palveluita
Aiempi kokemus myyntityöstä on etu, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme oikeaa asennetta, halua oppia ja rohkeutta onnistua.

Työllistyessäsi meille tarjoamme sinulle:

- Mahdollisuuden päästä osaksi energistä ja kannustavaa myyntitiimiä
- Selkeän perehdytyksen, jonka avulla pääset nopeasti vauhtiin
- Esihenkilön ja tiimin jatkuvan tuen onnistumiseesi
- Tehtävän, jossa pääset kehittämään myynnin, vuorovaikutuksen ja asiakastyön taitojasi
- Palkkamallin, jossa hyvä työ näkyy konkreettisesti ansioissa provisioiden kautta
- Työajat, jotka mahdollistavat työn ja muun arjen yhteensovittamisen

Työajat ja palkkaus

Työ on määräaikainen ajalla 1.9.2026-31.12.2026 ja töitä on tarjolla 30 tuntia viikossa. Työpäivät sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiville klo 9.00-15.00. Työajoista voidaan myös sopia joustavasti tilanteen mukaan.

Palkkauksessa noudatetaan ICT-alan työehtosopimusta. Kiinteän tuntipalkan 12,70 € / h lisäksi käytössä on provisiomalli, jonka ansiosta voit vaikuttaa omiin ansioihisi. Nykyiset myyjämme ansaitsevat provisioita keskimäärin noin 300-400 euroa kuukaudessa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae tehtävää mahdollisimman pian, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Odotamme hakijalta ennen kaikkea oikeaa asennetta, halua onnistua sekä innostusta myyntityöhön. Tule mukaan tekemään tuloksia osana kannustavaa tiimiä!

Mikäli jokin asia jäi mietityttämään, niin olethan rohkeasti yhteydessä. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Baronan henkilöstökonsultti Anni Kivimäki (anni.kivimaki@barona.fi).

HUOM! Tehtävässä tarvitaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia.

jobs.title: LEAD DATA STEWARD
jobs.description:
Company description:

Scandinavian Airlines System SAS

Job description:  Challenges you will work on:  

At SAS we are passionate about using data as a strategic asset to reshape Scandinavian aviation. That starts with trusted, well-governed data. As our Lead Data Steward, you will play a foundational role in ensuring that SAS data is accurate, consistent, secure, and fit for AI and analytics.



We are looking for an experienced Lead Data Steward to establish and drive data governance at SAS. You will define how data quality, metadata, data lineage, and access policies are managed across the organization — making data usable and trusted across AI, analytics, and business operations.



As Lead data steward you will work at the intersection of business, technology, and compliance. You will collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Architects, Legal, and business stakeholders to embed governance into data products and pipelines from the start.







Your responsibilities include:




    Define and drive the SAS data governance framework: policies, standards, processes, and ownership model.  
    Build and maintain the enterprise data catalogue ensuring metadata, definitions, lineage, and ownership are documented and up to date.  
    Establish and monitor data quality standards across critical data domains (customer, loyalty, commercial, operations).  
    Lead the data stewardship network across business units, ensuring accountability at domain level  
    Collaborate with Legal, Security, and IT to ensure compliance with relevant regulations.  
    Drive data classification and access management practices in partnership with IT Security.

    



The Team  

SAS is building a modern Data & AI function that owns the strategic direction for data and AI across the company, from portfolio and roadmap to governance, compliance, and solution architecture.



We work closely with business units and technical teams to ensure that the data foundation is trusted, scalable, and fit for future growth. We define the frameworks, standards, and practices that enable our data scientists, data and AI engineers, and analysts to move fast.



As our Data & AI capabilities continue to grow, data governance has become increasingly business critical. We are looking for a lead who can help establish and scale this capability across SAS.





     To be successful we believe you have  


    A degree in information management, computer science, data management, or a related field.  
    At least 5 years of experience in data governance, data management, or related discipline.  
    Hands-on experience with data catalogue tools (e.g. Collibra, Alation, Microsoft Purview) and data quality platforms.  
    Strong understanding of data management frameworks.  
    Experience defining data ownership models and partnering with business and technical data stewards.  
    Knowledge of GDPR and data privacy regulations and their practical implications for data governance.  
    Ability to translate technical data concepts into clear business language for non-technical stakeholders.  
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills — you will influence without authority.  
    A structured, methodical approach combined with the ability to prioritize in a fast-moving environment.  

      







     Our Culture at SAS  

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!



Come and fly with us!





     Additional information  


    Apply by: 11/09/2026. We review applications continuously, so please send us your CV as soon as you can. The role may be filled before the deadline.  
    Start and scope: Full-time role, starting with a 6-month probation period.  
    Location: You’ll be based at our office in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. This is mainly an onsite role, with some flexibility for remote work depending on the agreement with your manager.  
    Security: As this role is security classified, a background check will be part of the final stage of the recruitment process.







If you have any questions about the role, please contact Jonas Blomqvist, Head of Analytics & Data, at jonas.blomqvist@sas.se. Please note that, due to GDPR, we can’t accept applications by email.

jobs.title: LEAD DATA ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Company description:

Scandinavian Airlines System SAS

Job description:  Challenges you will work on:  

At SAS, data is the engine behind everything we build from AI models and personalized offers to real-time operational intelligence. As Lead Data Engineer, you will strengthen the engineering foundation that makes all of it possible: reliable, scalable, well-operated data products, pipelines, and integrations. You will work closely with the Data Architect to turn architectural direction into practical engineering standards, modern DataOps practices, and production-ready solutions that create real business impact.



We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer who will act as a senior engineering leader and close partner to the Data Architect, driving the development of scalable and reliable data solutions across SAS. You will lead the implementation of engineering standards for data testing, observability, monitoring, , SLAs, version control, and DataOps practices, while supporting teams in adopting modern software engineering practices.



You will work at the technical frontier of our data stack, leading implementation choices, code reviews, technical standards, and engineering quality across data products, pipelines, and integrations. In close collaboration with the Data Architect, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will bring modern perspectives on data products, DataOps, and software engineering craft, while ensuring solutions are aligned with the broader enterprise architecture and stakeholder priorities.



As Lead Data Engineer you will bring deep engineering expertise and hands-on DataOps leadership, helping transform architectural intent into robust, maintainable, and production-ready solutions.



Your responsibilities include:




    Lead the design, development, and operation of scalable data pipelines, data products, and integrations.  
    Establish and drive engineering standards for testing, documentation, observability, monitoring, , SLAs, version control, and DataOps.  
    Partner with the Data Architect to translate architectural direction into practical implementation patterns and reusable engineering standards.  
    Lead code reviews and drive continuous improvement of engineering practices across the team.  
    Mentor and support data engineers and DataOps engineers in modern tools, standards, and software engineering practices.  
    Collaborate with architecture, data stewardship, IT, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet quality, security, governance and operational requirements.

    



The Team  

The Analytics & Data team develops and manages the data infrastructure that powers AI, analytics, and business operations at SAS. We build and maintain data pipelines, data products, and enterprise integrations on a modern cloud platform.



Working closely with the AI & Automation team, analysts, and business units across SAS we ensure that trusted and accessible data is available where it is needed. Our work spans batch and near-real-time pipelines, data product development, and integration with core operational systems.



As SAS continues to expand its AI and analytics capabilities — including a new Customer Data Platform, agentic AI pilots, and an expanding BI estate — the demand for high-quality and well-engineered data infrastructure continues to grow. We are looking for a lead who can drive this forward.





     To be successful we believe you have  


    A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.  
    At least 5 years of hands-on data engineering experience, including experience in a senior or lead role.  
    Strong skills in SQL and Python, with experience in Spark or similar distributed processing frameworks.  
    Experience building and operating cloud-based data pipelines, preferably in Azure using services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse, or equivalent.  
    Solid understanding of data modelling, data warehouse design, data lake architecture, and enterprise data solutions.  
    Practical experience with DataOps, version control, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and operational SLAs.  
    Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, Prefect, Lakeflow, or dbt.  
    Strong mentoring skills and an passion for helping others grow through clear standards, documentation, and practical guidance.  
    A collaborative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bring practical engineering perspectives into architectural discussions.  

          



    



Additional information  


    Apply by: 11/09/2026. We review applications continuously, so please send us your CV as soon as you can. The role may be filled before the deadline.  
    Start and scope: Full-time role, starting with a 6-month probation period.  
    Location: You’ll be based at our office in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. This is mainly an onsite role, with some flexibility for remote work depending on the agreement with your manager.  
    Security: As this role is security classified, a background check will be part of the final stage of the recruitment process.  



If you have any questions about the role, please contact Jonas Blomqvist, Head of Analytics & Data, at jonas.blomqvist@sas.se. Please note that, due to GDPR, we can’t accept applications by email.

Aligned with our innovative owners, Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.

For this role, we are looking for someone who is reliable, guest-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced restaurant environment. You take pride in creating a welcoming atmosphere, enjoy working both independently and with a team, and are motivated by providing attentive, high-quality service that exceeds guest expectations.

As a Breakfast Service Associate, you will ensure that our guests begin their day with an outstanding breakfast experience. You will contribute to maintaining our dining areas, delivering personalized service, and upholding the hotel’s standards of quality and hospitality.

    Deliver exceptional breakfast and private dining service while taking guest orders and ensuring timely in-room deliveries.
    Maintain the breakfast buffet throughout the service period, ensuring all items are consistently replenished, fresh, and attractively presented.

    Strong teamwork and communication skills.

In addition:
You are a reliable and service-oriented team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced, event-focused environment.

Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application deadline, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location.
