jobs.title: Personleg assistent
jobs.description:
Søker vikar snarest og til 1 oktober med mulighet for forlenging eventuelt ringe vikar avtale.

Jeg er en hyggelig voksen dame som trenger assistanse. Jeg søker serviceinnstilt, ærlig og pliktoppfyllende personlig assistent for praktiske arbeidsoppgaver i og utenfor hjemmet. Jeg bruker rullestol utenfor hjemmet.

Arbeidstid vil være dag, ettermiddag og en sjelden gang helg. Dette kan til dels tilpasses etter assistentens ønske.

Ingen utdanning er nødvendig da opplæring vil bli gitt. Personlig egenhet vil bli vektlagt, og grunna arbeidets art oppfordres kvinner til å søke.

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli kalt inn til intervju forløpende.

Det er en fordel med eigen bil og førerkort klasse B.

Om arbeidsleder

Min søster er fungerende arbeidsleder, hun heter Eva Helen, ta gjerne kontakt med henne om du har spørsmål.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Matlaging og/eller tilrettelegging av måltid

  • Assistere med aktiviteter og daglige gjøremål

  • Assistere med personlig hygiene

  • Husarbeid

Hva forventer jeg av deg?

  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne

  • Du må være punktlig og pålitelig

  • Du må være fleksibel og serviceinnstilt

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Arbeidstid

  • Dag

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Uloba - en ideell organisasjon og en del av Independent Living-bevegelsen. 1500 medlemmer -- alle med egenerfaring som funksjonshemmet. Vi arbeider for full likestilling, samfunnsdeltakelse og livsutfoldelse for funksjonshemmede. Målet er likeverdige og verdiskapende samfunnsborgere.

Vår visjon; en verden der funksjonshemmede har frihet til livsutfoldelse og deltar på alle samfunnets arenaer. Gjennom vår politikk, vårt arbeid og vår visjon skal vi;

• Endre samfunnets oppfatning av funksjonshemmede, og samtidig endre funksjonshemmedes oppfatning av seg selv

• Arbeide aktivt for full likestilling, samfunnsdeltakelse og livsutfoldelse for funksjonshemmede

• Aktivt bekjempe diskriminering, umyndiggjøring, sykeliggjøring og institusjonalisering av funksjonshemmede.

Vi legger til rette for Borgerstyrt Personlig Assistanse (BPA) - et frigjøringsverktøy for funksjonshemmede med assistansebehov.

Våre verdier: Stolt, Sterk og Synlig!

jobs.title: Mechanical R&D Designer
jobs.description:
**Mechanical Design Engineer**

As our operations continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to strengthen our Product Development team.

In this role, you will be involved in the design, development, and lifecycle management of DYNASET products, working alongside some of the industry's leading experts. We are looking for a person with a genuine interest in machinery, product development, and creating new solutions. Previous years of experience are not the key factor for success in this role. What matters most is a willingness to learn and develop professionally.

As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will work closely with several departments across the company.

**We expect you to have**

- A Bachelors or Masters degree in Engineering

- Some experience in mechanical design; knowledge of steel structures is considered an advantage

- A systematic, energetic, and goal-oriented approach to work

- A desire to develop both your own expertise and that of your team, while supporting the expansion of the business into new areas

- Experience with and understanding of mobile machinery and machine-mounted attachments is considered an advantage.

- Communications skills in Finnish and English are required.


We use design software such as SolidWorks, Windchill PLM, and E3. Previous experience with these tools is beneficial but not required.

**What we offer**

We offer a modern working environment where you can develop your expertise alongside top professionals in advanced technology products. We invest in employee wellbeing through various sports, cultural, and wellness benefits, and you will also have access to our own on-site gym.

This position provides an opportunity to grow professionally through diverse and responsible tasks in an international business environment. Teamwork is important to us, and we believe in working together to achieve success. You will be supported by a skilled team and equipped with modern tools to help you succeed. We offer flexible working hours and a mobile phone benefit.

We value strong expertise, and every permanent employment relationship begins with a comprehensive onboarding programme covering our products and their manufacturing processes.

jobs.title: Finance Specialist needed!
jobs.description:
Ready to drive financial precision in a fast-paced, international automotive environment? We are looking for a hands-on Finance Specialist to join our client’s team. In this role, you will handle day-to-day financial operations, manage dealership-specific transactions, and support cross-border European compliance. If you bring strong numerical accuracy, love collaborating across operations, and thrive in an international setting, this is your next career step!

About the position

We at Perido are now looking for a Finance Specialist for our client. The position is based in Stockholm.

Your daily tasks:

    Accounting & Financial Operations: Process invoices, payments, employee expenses, bank transactions, and daily accounting activities in line with European requirements.
    AP & AR Management: Support supplier and customer accounts, reconcile balances, monitor schedules, and handle payment follow-ups.
    Vehicle & Dealership Finance: Maintain accurate financial records for vehicle purchases, sales, inventory movements, trade-ins, deposits, and commissions.
    Reporting & Reconciliations: Prepare financial reports, perform bank and ledger reconciliations, and resolve accounting discrepancies.
    European Market Compliance: Manage VAT, documentation, and compliance requirements for international European market transactions.
    Cross-Border Settlements: Assist with multi-currency transactions, foreign supplier/customer settlements, and international documentation.
    Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the primary finance contact for operations, sales, procurement, and external partners to ensure smooth execution.
    Process Improvement & Closing: Support month-end close processes, maintain clean accounting records, and optimize operational finance workflows.

Your characteristics

You are an analytical, highly organized professional who takes pride in precision and structure. Driven by a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset, you comfortably navigate complex financial data and multi-market transactions with ease. You possess natural diplomatic skills and an adaptable nature, allowing you to build strong working relationships across diverse operational teams. Calm under pressure and proactive by nature, you take initiative to smooth out process bottlenecks and consistently meet critical financial deadlines.

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!

Qualifications:

    Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
    1-2 years of proven experience in general accounting, AP/AR, and bank reconciliations
    Practical knowledge of European VAT regulations, invoicing standards, and foreign-currency transactions
    Strong proficiency in modern ERP/accounting systems and Excel
    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

Contract type and hours

Full-time consulting assignment for 12 months. Estimated start 2026-10-01.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 35953 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

We offer the chance to develop your finance career with hands-on exposure to purchasing, ledgers and reconciliation across a growing organisation.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Company description:

Volvo Cars

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

At Volvo Cars, we are on a mission to provide freedom to move in a personal, sustainable, and safe way. As vehicles become increasingly connected and software-defined, cybersecurity is a critical enabler of safety, trust, regulatory compliance, and customer confidence.







We are now looking for a Senior CSMS Engineer to strengthen cybersecurity governance and engineering coordination within ConX / Head Unit Platform. The Head Unit Platform organization provides and maintains the core infotainment platform that powers the in-car experience. It is responsible for platform engineering, software releases, ECU/head unit ownership, and functional safety, ensuring a stable and scalable foundation for all customer-facing applications and vehicle functions.  In this role, you will help ensure that cybersecurity activities are planned, executed, reviewed, traced, and evidenced in line with the Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS), UNECE R155, and ISO/SAE 21434 expectations.







You will work closely with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, software developers, system architects, verification teams, suppliers, Shield / central CSMS stakeholders, CSAP / Quality, and PSIRT to make ConX cybersecurity work products audit-ready and delivery-focused.

     What you'll do  


    Drive CSMS execution and coordination for ConX / Head Unit Platform cybersecurity activities across planning, development, verification, release, and post-development support




    Coordinate creation, review readiness, and lifecycle maintenance of cybersecurity work products such as CSPD, TARA, Cybersecurity Concept, cybersecurity requirements, verification specifications, SWTR, CSPV, CS Case / CAC, CS-SOW, and CSJR evidence




    Ensure traceability from cybersecurity requirements to verification activities, validation evidence, Software Test Reports (SWTR), and cybersecurity case evidence




    Support TARA activities by facilitating risk discussions, aligning security goals and risk treatment decisions, and ensuring outputs are reflected in security concepts and requirements




    Coordinate audit and homologation readiness by tracking evidence completeness, Teamcenter publication/release status, review records, and open gaps before they become certification blockers




    Act as the ConX interface towards Shield / central CSMS support on CSMS questions, templates, process alignment, compliance expectations, and evidence status




    Prepare and maintain CSMS delivery status, governance dashboards, risk summaries, and escalation material for Product Owners, Engineering Managers, ART leadership, and central cybersecurity stakeholders




    Coordinate confirmation review and assessment preparation with CSAP / Quality, ensuring verification review findings are closed and work products are ready for independent review




    Support supplier cybersecurity coordination by following up CS-SOW / CSJR expectations, supplier evidence status, and supplier-related cybersecurity risks or deviations




    Contribute to vulnerability-management and PSIRT-related coordination by ensuring ConX impact assessments, remediation evidence, and updated CSMS work products are aligned when cybersecurity issues affect infotainment scope




    Coach and guide ARTs and feature teams on CSMS expectations, cybersecurity documentation quality, evidence creation, and secure-by-design ways of working




    Continuously improve the local ConX CSMS operating model by identifying bottlenecks, ownership gaps, recurring evidence issues, and opportunities to simplify delivery while maintaining compliance

     What you'll bring  

To succeed in this role, you bring strong cybersecurity process knowledge, engineering judgement, and the ability to coordinate complex technical deliveries across multiple teams:




    University degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent experience




    7+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, automotive software development, system engineering, compliance engineering, product governance, or related technical roles




    Solid understanding of automotive cybersecurity lifecycle activities, including cybersecurity planning, TARA, cybersecurity concepts, requirements, verification, validation, and cybersecurity cases




    Practical knowledge of CSMS expectations and regulatory frameworks such as UNECE R155 and ISO/SAE 21434




    Experience coordinating cybersecurity work products, evidence chains, review preparation, and audit or certification readiness activities




    Ability to work across organizational boundaries with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, architects, software teams, verification teams, suppliers, and central process stakeholders




    Strong communication skills with the ability to translate cybersecurity compliance needs into practical engineering actions




    Structured way of working, with confidence in tracking deliverables, risks, dependencies, deviations, and decisions




    Ability to challenge unclear ownership, identify traceability gaps, and drive resolution pragmatically without losing stakeholder alignment
    Comfortable working in agile / ART-based development environments where compliance deliverables must be integrated into product planning and release execution

jobs.title: Tre inn i en variert og givende hverdag som personlig assistent!
jobs.employer: STENDI AS REGION VEST AVD KONTOR ROGALAND
jobs.description:
Vi søker en engasjert og løsnings orientert BPA-assistent for en ung mann i 20-årene som studerer ved universitetet. Han bor på Høle og på grunn av begrensede bussforbindelser er det en fordel om du har bil. Han har alltid godt humør, liker å lage litt leven rundt seg, og setter pris på gode samtaler, enten det handler om studier, gaming eller en serie man bare må diskutere.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som møter livet med et smil, også når ting ikke går helt etter planen. Du er typen som tenker «jaja, dette fikser vi» i stedet for «å nei, en hindring!». Du er fleksibel, positiv og liker å skape en god stemning rundt deg. En god prat skremmer deg ikke, og du trives med en arbeidshverdag der både ro, humor og litt hverdagskaos kan forekomme.
Du må ha førerkort, da du vil være vedtakseiers faste sjåfør til og fra universitetet. (Ingen racing, men gjerne god musikk i bilen!)

Arbeidsoppgaver
Du vil støtte vedtakseier i både daglige rutiner og studieliv. Oppgavene kan blant annet omfatte

-Bistand med personlig stell
-Assistere med transport til og fra universitet (bil)
-Bidra med praktiske gjøremål som gjør livet litt enklere og dagen litt bedre
-Tilrettelegging for studier, fritid og aktiviteter
-Å være en trygg og trivelig støtteperson gjennom dagen

Arbeidstid
Jeg trenger nå fast assistent som kan jobbe 1-2 dager i uken, samt en tilkallings assistent som kan jobbe ved behov. Enten det er dag, kveld eller helg.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?
Send oss gjerne en søknad hvor du forteller litt om deg selv, hvorfor du ønsker stillingen, og hva du kan bidra med. Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

jobs.title: Er du min nye assistent?
jobs.description:
Jeg ble i februar 2022 rammet av hjerneblødning og ble etter det avhengig av en god del hjelp i hverdagen min. Nå trener jeg for å komme tilbake til den aktive og sterke dama jeg var. Derfor søker jeg nå etter en BPA-assistent som kan hjelpe meg med å nå dette målet. BPA står for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse og er et likestillings- og frigjøringsverktøy som gir meg frihet til å leve det livet jeg ønsker, til tross for min funksjonsnedsettelse.

Jeg er en voksen dame på 68 år som bor sammen med min samboer på Kattem. Der har vi byens flotteste utsikt - den må bare oppleves. Der koser jeg meg i hagen på sommeren. Vi er så heldige å ha en hytte, og målet mitt er å også kunne tilbringe tid litt der.

Pr i dag er jeg avhengig av hjelp til forflytning, det kan være mellom seng, rullestol, toalett og godstol. Jeg har hjelpemidler tilgjengelig, men det er en fordel om du er stødig selv også. Jeg trenger også hjelp i forbindelse med måltider. Målet mitt er at jeg skal få til dette selv og det betyr at jeg må trene mye. Det man trener mye på, blir man jo god på som du vet. Jeg trener mye på å gå, enn så lenge med støtte og en medhjelper. Jeg er sensitiv for sterke lukter som f.eks. parfyme så dette må du som assistent ta hensyn til.

Jeg har også behov for følge og hjelp når jeg skal ut av huset for f.eks. legebesøk eller for andre ærend. Jeg får hjelp av hjemmetjenesten både morgen og kveld, som hjelper meg med å stå opp og med morgenstellet. Der trenger jeg også din bistand, som jeg også vil trenge ved toalettbesøk. Alle mine forflytninger og gjøremål er trening for meg, for å nå mitt mål om å klare meg selv i hverdagen, slik jeg gjorde før hjerneblødningen.

Har du noe erfaring fra helsesektoren vil det være positivt.

Kunne du tenke deg å være denne medhjelperen?

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Huslige oppgaver
  • Være med på ærend
  • Trening
  • Litt handling

Arbeidstid:

De fleste vaktene vil være på dagtid, men har du mulighet til å jobbe en ettermiddag eller kveld innimellom er det fint.

Størrelse på stilling blir vi enige om, det vil være viktig at vi har en god kjemi og vi trives sammen.


Om Solid Assistanse og BPA:

Vår målsetning er å være den foretrukne leverandøren av BPA. Med sterkt fokus på skreddersøm av løsninger og en uslåelig tilgjengelighet er vi der for deg når du måtte trenge det.

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help shape a future identity and access setup in a large, complex public-sector environment. The focus is on evaluating and designing how account provisioning and authentication should work between on-premises Active Directory and Google Workspace as part of a new AD structure. You will compare different technical approaches, explain trade-offs clearly, and recommend the solution that best fits the customer’s needs.

A key part of the role is to assess whether the current setup should continue with Google Cloud Directory Sync (GCDS), transition to Entra ID for account synchronization, or move toward another suitable approach. You will also evaluate the right federation solution for the future target state and outline how the transition should be handled during an account migration to a new Active Directory environment. This is a great opportunity if you enjoy solving complex identity architecture challenges and turning them into clear, actionable recommendations.

Job Description

    You will design and document account provisioning flows between on-premises Active Directory and Google Workspace.
    You will design and document authentication flows for the future identity setup.
    You will evaluate whether the current synchronization approach should remain with GCDS, move to Entra ID, or follow another solution path.
    You will assess federation options for a future-state architecture and explain the pros and cons of each alternative.
    You will provide clear recommendations that support technical decision-making in a complex environment.
    You will develop a practical plan for managing identity-related changes during migration to a new Active Directory structure.

Requirements

    Expertise in Google Workspace
    Expertise in Google Cloud Directory Sync (GCDS)
    Experience with federation solutions
    Experience with Entra ID
    Professional fluency in Swedish and English

Nice to have

    Good knowledge of Active Directory
    Good knowledge of tiering models

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

jobs.title: Contract Manager - Gripen FMV
jobs.description:
Your Future Challenges

You will join a team of experienced individuals responsible for both current contract deliveries as well as securing new contracts for the Gripen fighter system. You will have a direct impact on Saab's business outcome by shaping contract strategies, supporting negotiations and contributing to long-term customer partnerships.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Leading or be part of a cross-functional contract team including sub-contract managers, commercial, finance and product management
    Managing full contract lifecycle in Winning business and Execute business processes
    Leading contractual negotiations with customers and suppliers
    Representing Saab building trust and collaboration
    Working together with program management, contract managers and other Saab units to ensure delivery on our contractual obligations
    Driving follow-on sales opportunities and secure long-term contractual value
    Engaging in strategic discussions and business development
    Working closely with engineering teams to align customer needs with technical feasibility



This role demands strong operational management skills, high level of business and commercial awareness and a strong will to develop the way we do business with FMV. Some travel is required, mostly within Sweden.



Who You Are

We seek a driven and committed individual who thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You are a proactive and communicative professional who values relationship-building with both internal and external stakeholders. You possess a structured and efficient working style, capable of managing multiple complex tasks while maintaining a strategic perspective. You by example, inspiring and motivating others and create a highly engaged and collaborative environment.



Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

    Strong organizational skills with a proven ability to lead and coordinate across multiple stakeholders
    Strong negotiation skills and experience handling high-stakes business discussions
    Solid business and commercial understanding and a high level of self-motivation and persistence
    Demonstrated track record of ensuring timely, cost-effective and high-quality deliveries
    Ability to navigate cross-functional work within complex organizational structures
    Fluency in English (spoken and written)
    Experience in managing business relationships
    Experience working with the Gripen system is highly desirable
    Leadership experience or exposure to international business environments is a plus



This role requires security clearance as per defense confidentiality regulations. Therefore, candidates must pass a security clearance conducted by the relevant authorities.



About Saab Saab is a global leader in defense and security, specializing in air, land, and naval defense, civil security, and commercial aeronautics. With a workforce of 28,100 employees operating on all continents, we are at the forefront of technological innovation, investing one-fifth of our revenue in research and development.

At Saab, we offer more than just career advancement; we value diversity and a healthy work-life balance. We continuously push the boundaries of what is possible, collaborating with global teams who share a common goal: to make the world a safer place.



What You Will Be a Part Of

Aeronautics, a division within Saab, is responsible for the development, production, marketing, sales and support of the Gripen system. Aeronautics also provides aviation-related subsystems, unmanned aerial systems, aircraft structures and services to defense customers and the civil aviation industry.

The task of the Gripen Business Unit, a part of Aeronautics, is to ensure the development, production, testing, delivery and operation of the complete weapon system for both current and new customers. The assignment includes responsibility for delivering in accordance with current agreements, as well as coordination within Saab, subcontractors, partners and with our customers.

Within the Gripen Program and Systems Management department, we are looking for dedicated professionals to manage contracts with Swedish Defence Material Administration (FMV).

jobs.title: Saliapulainen/tarjoilija, Amarillo, Las Palmas & VENN Kotka
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KOTKA

Haussa on määräaikaiseen osa-aikaiseen (22,5 h/3 vkoa) työsuhteeseen

SALIAPULAINEN/TARJOILIJA, AMARILLO, LAS PALMAS & VENN KOTKA

Kotkan Amarillo, Las Palmas ja VENN kutsuvat viihtymään maukkaiden elämysten pariin. Monipuolinen ruokatarjonta, raikkaat juomat ja rento tunnelma luovat täydelliset puitteet niin illalliselle kuin yhteisiin hetkiin ystävien ja perheen kanssa. Tähän kokonaisuuteen kaipaamme vahvistukseksi työkaveria, joka on sanavalmis asiakaspalvelija ja luotettava tiimipelaaja. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisessa ympäristössä, jossa jokainen ilta on erilainen ja työt ihan tavallisia.

Olet äärimmäisen tärkeässä roolissa toteuttamassa asiakkaille ikimuistoisia iltoja ja rentoja hetkiä hyvän juoman ja tunnelman äärellä. Huolehdit omalta osaltasi nopeasta palvelusta ja tilojen siisteydestä. Tehtävänimike ja palkkaus määräytyvät aiemman kokemuksesi mukaan. Ilman alan aiempaa kokemusta, aloitat tehtävässä saliapulaisena, kokeneempana ravintola-alan osaajana voit työskennellä suoraan tarjoilijana, jolloin osallistut myös anniskeluun ja muuhun tarjoilijalle tyypilliseen työhön.

Hakijoilta toivomme:
💡 Hyvää asiakaspalveluasennetta sekä iloista ja energistä työotetta asiakkaiden ja työkavereiden iloksi.
💡 Hyvää paineensietokykyä ja joustavuutta. Meille se tarkoittaa sitä, että pääsi pysyy kylmänä myös kiireisinä hetkinä ja jaksat pysyä positiivisena myös silloin, kun työtehtävät vaihtuvat nopeasti ja yllättäen.
💡 Kyvykkyyttä fyysisesti raskaaseen työhön. Työpäivät kuluvat pääosin jalkojen päällä, askeleita kertyy päivittäin tuhansia ja ergonomiasta huolimatta työhön kuuluu esimerkiksi raskaita nostoja.
💡 Alan työkokemus katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä, sillä suurin osa työtehtävistä on opetettavissa. Hygienia- ja anniskelupassit katsomme eduksi.

Työn luonteen ja työvuorojen vuoksi hakijan tulee olla täysi-ikäinen. Työkielemme on suomi. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi. Lisäksi edellytämme valmiutta työskennellä kaikkina ravintoloiden aukioloaikoina, myös yövuoroissa.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
💚 Lokakuussa alkavan määräaikaisen työsuhteen, joka jatkuu tammikuuhun 2027 saakka.
💚 Kattavan perehdytyksen, jotta pystyt suoriutumaan työstäsi parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

💚 S-Ryhmän ylivoimaiset henkilöstöedut, jotka ovat käytettävissä kautta koko Suomen heti työsuhteen alusta alkaen.

jobs.title: Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
⚡️ What We Do

Swiftly gaining ground as Sweden’s industry leader in battery storage and expanding rapidly in selected European markets, Flower is on a mission to enable the energy system of tomorrow.

With an industry-leading AI-powered platform at its core, our service includes stabilizing the energy system by enhancing predictability and flexibility for both energy producers and consumers. By combining pioneering technology with a portfolio of flexible energy assets, we break new ground towards a fossil-free energy system, allowing clean energy to power society.

🌟Who We Are

Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core.﻿ Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.

At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.

To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Performance Engineer.

👩‍💻 About The Role:

As Performance Engineer, you'll join our Asset Management team and be an important part of monitoring and performance across Flower's growing portfolio of energy assets, including battery storage (BESS). You'll ensure our assets run at industry-standard availability by proactively detecting issues before they cause downtime, managing incident escalation, and continuously improving how we monitor performance through our asset management platform. You'll also play a key role in turning operational data into insights that feed directly into our optimization models - helping us make smarter decisions and unlock long-term value from every asset in the portfolio.

What You’ll Do:

    

Monitor and ensure the performance and availability of Flower's energy assets

    

Onboard new and existing assets into our monitoring platform, configuring data points and validating that signals and alarms are correctly set up

    

Drive proactive, data-driven analysis to catch potential failures early and minimize unplanned downtime

    

Coordinate with external partners, suppliers, and system integrators to troubleshoot issues and improve data integration

    

Maintain clear downtime reporting and track KPIs to keep asset health transparent across the organization

Who You Are:

    

You have a technical degree with a focus on energy systems or equivalent proven experience within Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and/or energy production

    

Strong technical understanding of energy asset hardware, cloud integrations and industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, IoT gateways)

    

You bring minimum 3-5 years of experience working with performance monitoring or operations on energy assets

    

Proven ability to analyze complex data sets to perform predictive maintenance and fault detection

    

Strong interpersonal skills for high-stakes coordination with external partners, subcontractors, and emergency rescue services

    

Strong communication skills in English both written and spoken                                                              

    

Confident cross-company communication skills, able to liaise and coordinate effectively with external partners, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholder organizations

📍 Location

Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.

✉️ Apply

Our corporate language is English, as we have about 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.

Throughout the recruitment process you will meet with the Talent Partner, the Hiring Manager, the Team, and the VP Engineering.

We look forward to hearing from you!

—

We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.

jobs.title: BPA-assistent søkes – praktisk, selvgående og med glimt i øyet ✨
jobs.description:
Jeg er en dame i 40-årene som søker en BPA-assistent som er mer enn bare en hjelper –en person som ser hva som trengs å gjøres, tar initiativ og bidrar til at hverdagen flyter godt.

Livet mitt forandret seg brått, og jeg har derfor fått behov for mer hjelp og støtte i hverdagen enn jeg hadde tidligere. Nå ønsker jeg å finne deg som kan bidra til at dagene blir enklere, mer oversiktlige og samtidig fylte med hyggelige opplevelser.

Det er en fast stilling på ca. 20 %, og jeg søker også tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov.

Arbeidstidene er fordelt på både dag og kveldsvakter, så det er viktig at du kan være fleksibel med tanke på arbeidstid.

Jeg ser etter en person som ser hva som trengs å gjøres, tar initiativ og bidrar til at hverdagen flyter godt. Du trenger ikke en detaljert liste for å komme i gang. Det er en stor fordel om du er observant, har god hukommelse for avtaler og planer.

Jeg ser etter deg som er:

  • Selvgående og ansvarsbevisst
  • Praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert
  • Fleksibel og spontan
  • Leken, eventyrlysten og har humor
  • Snill, omsorgsfull og omgjengelig
  • Glad i mennesker, dyr og natur
  • Komfortabel med både rolige og aktive dager

Det er også fint om du er åpen for alternative behandlingsformer, og har du interesse for spiritualitet, er det et pluss. Det viktigste for meg er likevel at du er åpen, respektfull og en person det er lett å trives sammen med.

Alder er ikke det viktigste. Kanskje er du mellom 35 og 60 år isj, men jeg er også åpen for yngre søkere som har en «gammel sjel» og den rette innstillingen.

Arbeidet vil variere mellom praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet, organisering, hverdagslige gjøremål, administrativ støtte og det å være med på aktiviteter og små eventyr. Noen dager trenger jeg mest praktisk hjelp og struktur, mens andre dager kan handle om å komme seg ut, gjøre noe hyggelig eller bare ha en rolig og fin dag.

Ingen dager er helt like, og dette passer derfor godt for deg som liker variasjon, tar ting litt på sparket og samtidig er trygg og stabil.

For meg handler BPA om mer enn hjelp til praktiske ting. Det handler om å få tilbake mer frihet, spontanitet og livskvalitet etter at livet plutselig tok en annen retning.

Høres dette ut som deg? Da vil jeg veldig gjerne høre fra deg! ✌🏻😊


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Assistant Professors and/or Associate Professors in Clinical and Preventive Odontology
jobs.description:
Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark is seeking two motivated individuals for two fixed-term appointments (2 years, up to 37 hours per week, with the possibility of extension). The successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute to the establishment of the newly established Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and to play an active role in the development of the upcoming educational programmes for dentists and dental hygienists.

These positions offer a rare opportunity to influence the development of education, research, and clinical teaching from the very beginning, while joining an ambitious academic community dedicated to excellence, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

About the positions

We are seeking candidates with a broad background in dentistry and an interest in the development of university education.

We welcome applicants with diverse dental competencies and subspecialties, for example within:

  • Cariology and Endodontics

  • Periodontology

  • Prosthodontics

  • Orthodontics

  • Oral Surgery

  • Oral Medicine

  • Paediatric Dentistry

  • Clinical Dentistry in General

  • Preventive Dentistry

  • Digital Dentistry

The decisive factor is not your subspecialty alone, but your commitment to contributing to the development of a modern, research-led education in dentistry.

 

Main responsibilities

 

As part of the establishment and development of the department, you will be expected to contribute actively to:

  • the development of the new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, which are expected to commence in the summer of 2027

  • the planning and development of courses and teaching activities

  • teaching at both undergraduate and graduate levels

  • teaching dentistry and dental hygiene students

  • the development of clinical learning activities, simulation-based training, and competency-based education

  • student assessment and supervision

  • collaboration with clinical instructors, private training clinics, and other external partners

  • the development of the department’s teaching and learning environment

  • the development and implementation of research projects within clinical and preventive dentistry

  • scientific publishing and dissemination of research findings

  • the development of national and international research collaborations

  • securing external research funding and contributing to grant applications

Teaching will be based on evidence-based dentistry and will emphasize the close integration of basic sciences, clinical skills, and patient care.

Research

The department is concurrently establishing the Research Unit APEX, which aims to build strong national and international research environments within clinical and preventive dentistry.

We are therefore seeking candidates with an interest in research and academic development.

To be successful in this position, we expect you:

  • have documented research experience

  • have published scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals

  • are motivated to further develop your own research profile

  • have an interest in interdisciplinary and international collaboration.

The research component of the position will be tailored to the individual candidate’s qualifications and career stage.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • hold a degree in Dentistry

  • have obtained a PhD degree

  • hold Danish authorization to practice as a dentist, or meet the requirements for obtaining Danish authorization

  • combine strong clinical competencies with a well-developed scientific and analytical mindset

  • are motivated to contribute actively to the development of a new dental department

  • thrive in an interdisciplinary university environment

  • possess strong collaborative and interpersonal skills.

In addition, the following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • documented teaching experience

  • experience with curriculum development

  • experience supervising students

  • experience from specialist training or other advanced areas of clinical expertise.

For candidates appointed as Assistant Professors, participation in the Lecturer Training Programme (Universitetspædagogikum) is planned as part of the appointment.

 

Appointment to the positions requires academic qualifications at PhD level and in accordance with the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

 

What we offer

You will become part of a growing department with a unique opportunity to make a significant academic and professional impact.

Among other things, we offer:

  • the opportunity to help shape new educational programmes from the ground up

  • a strong research-based university environment

  • close integration of research, clinical practice, and teaching

  • excellent opportunities for academic career development

  • the opportunity to contribute to the establishment and development of the Research Unit APEX

  • an engaged and ambitious collegial environment with a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and innovation.

About the department

The Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) aims to advance and disseminate new knowledge within dentistry through excellent research, research-based education in SDU’s new Dentistry and Dental Hygiene programmes, and close collaboration with the healthcare sector.

The Department will educate the next generation of dentists and dental hygienists through research-based teaching, modern simulation and clinical training, and close engagement with the wider healthcare system, supported by a strong international research environment of the highest academic standard.

Our vision is to create a strong, internationally oriented research and educational environment where clinical excellence, evidence-based practice, and interdisciplinary collaboration go hand in hand.

Application deadline

October 19, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Contact

Further information about the position may be obtained from Professor and Head of Research Torben H. Thygesen, tthygesen@health.sdu.dk, +45 22 34 13 64, or Acting Head of Department and Dean Jakob Grauslund jgrauslund@health.sdu.dk, +45 93 50 70 42.

Salary and terms of employment 

The applicants will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as assistant professor or associate professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. 

In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor or associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application 

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total): 

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 3 for assistant professors, and 6 associate professors, scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy 

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.   

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Assessment 

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process.  

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.  

Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

Join us in shaping the future of dentistry

We are seeking ambitious colleagues who wish to contribute to more than teaching alone. We invite dentists with a passion for academic development, research, and education to join us in building a new academic environment and educating the oral healthcare professionals of the future.

Together, we are creating the foundation for Denmark’s newest Department of Clinical and Preventive Odontology and shaping the future of dental education and research.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Pædagogisk aflaster til teenagepige med autisme og epilepsi til ugentlig fast vagt på Vesterbro
jobs.description:
Har du pædagogisk erfaring, et roligt nervesystem og lyst til at gøre en konkret forskel i et barns hverdag?
Vi søger en deltidsmedarbejder som aflaster til en pige på 13 år på Vesterbro. Stillingen består af  en fast ugentligt vagt på 5–6 timer ad gangen, primært mandage og fredage

 

Om pigen

Du bliver en del af hverdagen hos en 13-årig pige med autisme og PCDH19-syndrom, som betyder, at hun indimellem kan få epileptiske anfald. Opgaven består i at aflaste mor , ved at hjælpe med at give støtte til struktur, aktiviteter og tryghed i hverdagen.

Pigen kan være nærværende, glad og aktiv – og samtidig have behov for skærmning og ro, når hun bliver angst, kravundgående, emotionelt svingende eller overstimuleret. Det kan fx ske, hvis hun får for mange valgmuligheder eller mødes af stramme krav.

Hun er god til at aflæse andres følelser, men har brug for støtte til selv at regulere sine egne. Hun trives bedst sammen med voksne, der møder hende med tålmodighed, forudsigelighed og forståelse, og som kan være et roligt spejl for hende.

Hun holder særligt af:

  • at bygge/lege m. LEGO
  • at spille UNO og Roblox
  • at synge og spille på Nintendo
  • at lege ude på legepladsen eller i gården

 

Opgavens indhold

Dine opgaver vil være pædagogisk støtte i hverdagen og kan bl.a. omfatte:

  • leg og samvær
  • pædagogiske aktiviteter som kreative projekter eller udeleg
  • støtte til struktur og forudsigelighed
  • brug af piktogrammer 
  • lettere praktiske opgaver (fx støvsugning, rengøring, tøj og sengetøj) – dette aftales løbende med mor og tilpasses pigens overskud for relationel kontakt

 

Vigtige forhold at være opmærksom på

  • Du skal altid have din telefon på dig, da hun kan finde på at gå ud ad døren (der er mulighed for at låse døre ved behov).
  • Fokus er på samvær frem for præstation – fx skal du ikke “gøre det bedre” end hende i aktiviteter, da det kan trigge hende.
  • Hun kan blive udadreagerende ved fysisk eller mental overbelastning.
  • Hun er sensitiv i forhold til berøring – man skal spørge om lov og samtidig kunne vurdere situationen fagligt.

 

Oplæring og sparring

  • Du vil få en obligatorisk oplæring ved mor samt evt. en kollega. I forhold til pigens epilepsi.
  • Du vil få en længere samtale med en af de faste medarbejdere på teamet, som klæder dig på til opgaven.
  • Der vil være løbende sparring, vejledning og personalemøder.

 

Arbejdstid, sted og vilkår

  • Stillingen er på få faste timer ugentligt, typisk 5–6 timers vagter. Arbejdstid på hverdage er fra kl. 15.00-20.00 (14.00-19.00) og i weekenden er det som udgangspunkt kl 10.00-16.00 eller efter aftale med mor. 
  • Arbejdsstedet er indre Vesterbro, København.
  • Du ansættes i Olivia Danmark og er omfattet af FOA-overenskomst. Løn fastsættes efter kvalifikationer.

 

Vi søger dig, som

  • har erfaring med autisme eller børn/unge med særlige behov
  • er tålmodig, empatisk og struktureret
  • kan skabe trygge rammer og være nærværende
  • kan samarbejde respektfuldt med pårørende og fagpersoner

 

Ansøgning og kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdeleder Maria Delcomyn på mail: maria.delcomyn@oliviadanmark.dk

Vi kalder løbende til samtale.

jobs.title: Servicetekniker | Skövde

Du jobbar självständigt men är alltid en del av teamet och du får ta ansvar för hela processen, från planering till återrapportering.     Reparationer och förebyggande underhåll av maskiner och utrustning.

    Självständigt arbete samt samarbete i team mot företag och organisationer.

Vi söker dig som har:

    B-körkort
    God datorvana
    God svenska i tal och skrift samt kunna behärska engelska i tal och skrift.

Vi ser gärna att du är resultat- och kostnadsmedveten. Som medarbetare hos Glaj kan du förvänta dig, men även själv arbeta aktivt för, att bli delaktig i och medveten om beslut som fattas.

Glaj erbjuder dig:

Om Glaj Glaj är en fullservicepartner med kundanpassade helhetslösningar i fokus. Vi har räddat dagen för våra kunder sedan 1954. Den personliga kontakten med våra kunder är vår främsta drivkraft och vi är stolta över att kunna erbjuda genomtänkta, anpassade lösningar som gör verklig skillnad i deras vardag.

jobs.title: Sykepleier - avdeling Natt-omsorgsbolig
jobs.description:
Trives du med å være våken når andre sover?

Vil du gjøre en forskjell for andre, og motiveres du av ansvar, faglig utvikling og godt samarbeid?

Vi utvikler omsorgstjenester ved Mydtbyen omsorgsbolig, og søker en engasjert sykepleier til vårt natt-team.

Vi har ledig en 80 % fast sykepleierstilling på natt.

Som nattevakt blir du en del av et stabilt og trivelig team på fem nattevakter som samarbeider tett og deler på oppgavene. Dette er en nyopprettet stilling, og vi ønsker en medarbeider som kan bidra med et godt faglig blikk og være med på å utvikle og sikre tjenestene i avdelingen.

Midtbyen hjemmetjeneste tilbyr tjenester både i omsorgsboliger og til brukere i ordinær hjemmetjeneste. Vi som jobber på Midtbyen hjemmetjeneste er med på skape en trygg og god arbeidsplass. Vi fokuserer på at våre ansatte har god fagkompetanse og er nysgjerrig på å lære. Faglig og personlig utvikling for den enkelte ansatte er viktig for oss.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Sykepleiere tillegges mange varierte oppgaver.
  • Hovedsakelig består de av sykepleiertjenester i brukerens hjem, men også i samarbeid med pårørende, forvaltningskontoret, fastlege og UNN.
  • Vi bruker primærkontakter for å ha kontinuitet og kvalitet i tjenesten.
  • Bruk av velferdsteknologi.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier.
  • Språkkunnskaper tilsvarende nivå B2. Dette gjelder søkere som ikke har norsk som morsmål, og som ikke kommer fra et av de skandinaviske landene.
  • Ved tilsetting vil relevant erfaring og personlig egnethet vektlegges.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Ansvarsbevisst og faglig reflektert.
  • Stor samarbeidsevne og god på relasjoner.
  • Pålitelig.
  • God på kommunikasjon.
Vi tilbyr
  • Stillingskode 7174 Sykepleier (årslønn 545 400 - 639 900 kr) - Spesialsykepleier 7523 (årslønn 586 400 - 673 200 kr).
  • En hyggelig arbeidsplass
  • Selvstendige arbeidsoppgaver med gode, faglige utviklingsmuligheter.
  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste.
  • Rabatt på treningssenter.
  • Gode kollektivforbindelse, sentralt arbeidsplass.
  • Tilsetting skjer i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglementer og tariffavtaler.
  • Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om.
  • Ved tilsetting må gyldig politiattest iht. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven §5-4 fremlegges.
  • Ved tilsetting kreves tuberkuloseundersøkelse for søkere som i løpet av de siste tre årene har oppholdt seg sammenhengende mer enn tre måneder i land med høy forekomst av tuberkulose iht. tuberkuloseforskriftens § 3.1 og 3.2.
  • Attester og vitnemål legges ved søknad før intervju.
  • Referanser registreres på forespørsel etter intervju.
  • Søknad sendes elektronisk via Webcruiter.
Kontaktinformasjon

June Elisabeth Eikrem, Avdelingsleder Skriverplassen og Natt- omsorgsbolig, 913 57 703, june.eikrem@tromso.kommune.no
Stephanie Langlois, Personalkonsulent, 902 22 747, stephanie.langlois@tromso.kommune.no

Arbeidssted

Seminarbakken 1
9008 TROMSØ

Nøkkelinformasjon:

Arbeidsgiver: Tromsø kommune

Referansenr.: 5166884740
Stillingsprosent: 80%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 09.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Midtbyen hjemmetjeneste er en enhet innen seksjon for hjemmetjenester i avdeling for helse og omsorg. Det er fem avdelinger i enheten. Tre avdelinger arbeider innen omsorgsboliger, og to avdelinger arbeider med utetjenester. Enheten tilbyr hjemmetjenester til brukere i egne hjem sentralt i byen, Nordbyen og i omsorgsboliger. Vi har primært eldre, men også en del yngre brukere med varierte behov. I tillegg til de fem avdelingene er fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten for voksne organisatorisk lagt under Midtbyen hjemmetjeneste. De tilbyr tjenester til alle kommunens innbyggere over 18 år. Våre lokaler ligger i Seminaret bo- og rehabiliteringssenter ved bruhodet sentralt på Tromsøya. Vi skal fokusere på å skape tjenester som hjelper brukerne våre til å bli så selvstendig og uavhengig som mulig.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Air China Stockholm

Mechanical Engineer

Air China is China’s only national flag carrier and a member carrier of the world’s largest airline network - Star Alliance. Air China Stockholm was established thirty-eight years ago, and it is constantly expanding. The company currently is seeking a new Mechanical Engineer to a growing Station team within the Air China Stockholm Office. The working location is Arlanda Airport Stockholm.

Job description:

1.Complete the airworthiness release of Air China aircraft at the station in accordance with the applicable maintenance management requirements, ensuring the continued airworthiness of Air China aircraft at the station and the normal operation of flights.

2. Be responsible for supervising and inspecting the work of contracted maintenance organizations in accordance with the maintenance agreements, and ensuring the implementation of management requirements for contracted maintenance organizations through timely communication, supervision, and inspection.

3. Be responsible for reporting the operational status of flights at the station to the AMC (Maintenance Control Center) and the outstation maintenance management department as required.

4. Be responsible for the management of Air China’s dedicated maintenance tools, equipment, and materials at the station.

5. Complete the training of contracted/appointed maintenance personnel in accordance with the requirements of the outstation maintenance management department.

6. Be responsible for organizing and coordinating the troubleshooting and rectification of major defects or malfunctions of Air China aircraft at the station, and for coordinating the provision of required maintenance materials and parts support.

7. Assist in completing various maintenance audits at the station and ensure adequate preparation for inspections and audits.

8.Assist the Station Manager with crew communication and station support/ground handling coordination.

Qualifications:

1.15 years or more of experience in aircraft maintenance.

2.A CAAC Aircraft Maintenance License with a type rating for at least one aircraft type.

3.Strong knowledge of operational safety, transportation services, flight revenue management, and cost control.

3.Proficiency in both Chinese and English is required; Chinese is mandatory.

4. Must be able and flexible to work variable schedules including overtime, weekends and holidays.

5.Work permit in Sweden.

6.A bachelor's degree or higher is required.

Air China Stockholm can offer:

1. Good career experience in the largest Chinese airline company.

2. A professional and dynamic work environment.

Please send your CV and cover letter in English to: nordic.hr@airchina.se



Region: Stockholm

Working hours: 40 hours per week, full time

Application deadline: 2026-09-11

Expected Start Date: As Soon As Possible

Location: Arlanda Airport Stockholm

Contact Infor: nordic.hr@airchina.se
