jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead the systems, data, and process work behind how we bill, recognize revenue, close the books, and prove our controls work.



You won't be writing the code or drawing the architecture; you'll be deciding what gets built, in what order, and why it matters. This is a role for someone who wants to understand a business well enough to change how it runs: learning the objectives, processes, and system flows end to end, then shaping them into strategic technical programs with real owners, deliberate sequencing, and decisions that hold up under audit. You'll sit between Finance and Accounting on one side and Engineering, Data, and Product on the other, and you'll be accountable for making new revenue streams operable and auditable, from a pricing model on a slide to a billed invoice, a booked journal entry, and a control that passes testing.



You'll report to the Lead Technical Program Manager for Data, Biztech & AI Transformation, within EPD. You'll get high-level direction and clear priorities from your manager, and independent ownership of how the work actually gets delivered. You'll bring engineering-side rigor and platform thinking to finance problems, and work as part of a team modernizing how the whole company operates.



Most of your time will go to three things: making new product and pricing launches work end to end in the finance stack, running the platforms and data flows behind quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and driving the IT general controls (ITGC) program so controls are designed into systems up front rather than retrofitted after go-live.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Act as Finance's technical counterpart on new product, pricing, and packaging launches, translating commercial models into requirements across order capture, rating and billing, tax, revenue recognition, and downstream reporting, and defining what "revenue-ready" means before go/no-go: who owns each piece, what's actually done versus asserted, and which risks are still cheap to fix

 - Broker the trade-off when a launch date and systems reality don't line up: a scoped manual workaround with an owner, a cost, and an expiration date, plus the path to the automated version. Then close the loop after launch on billing accuracy, exception rates, where revenue landed, whether the new controls actually operate, and what must be true to do this again at 10x volume

 - Independently own delivery and multi-quarter roadmaps for your finance systems programs, including ERP, billing and subscription management, CPQ, revenue subledger, procurement, and the reporting layer on top. Run the working groups that deliver them across Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Data, and Security, with clear accountability and updates leadership can read in two minutes

 - Run the operating rhythm: intake and prioritization, decision logs, early risk escalation, and a small set of metrics that show whether the work is actually improving anything, and flag early when committed scope and capacity don't line up

 - Map current-state processes and data lineage end to end and go after the breaks: reconciliation gaps, recurring manual journal entries, spreadsheets doing load-bearing work, competing sources of truth for the same metric. Partner with Data Engineering on the definitions and data contracts that let finance metrics tie cleanly to source systems, and hold the line when teams drift

 - Drive ITGC workstreams across in-scope financial systems: logical access and segregation of duties, change management, SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, job scheduling, and data interfaces. Partner with Internal Audit on scoping and control design, with a named owner for every control

 - Facilitate designing controls into new systems, systems changes, and launches before go-live with Controllership, Internal Audit, and Engineering, and serve as the systems-side point of contact for internal and external audit on ITGC walkthroughs and testing, translating between control language and engineering language, and driving deficiencies through root cause, named owners, evidence, and validation that the fix holds

 - Build AI-assisted workflows that expand what the teams around you can cover, and hold them to real standards: a defined task, a way to evaluate output quality, explicit human review gates on anything touching financial reporting, and documentation so someone else can run it




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 -  5+ years in technical program management, business systems, finance transformation, or a related field, with substantial time on finance or revenue systems; public-company or IPO-track experience is a strong plus

 - Working fluency in finance operations; you don't need to be an accountant, but you should hold your own on quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and know why revenue recognition is not the same as billing

 - Hands-on ITGC program experience across access, change management, and IT operations for in-scope financial systems, plus practical SOX knowledge. You understand how ITGC reliance determines what auditors will accept from automated controls and system-generated reports, can tell a key control from a non-key one, know where ITACs fit alongside ITGCs, and have been through remediation and audit cycles rather than only reading about them

 - AI-native operating mindset; this is a core requirement for this role. You already use AI to draft requirements, synthesize status, triage intake, and assemble evidence packages, and you share the patterns so others work differently because of what you built

 - A track record of independently delivering technical programs end to end, ideally transformation work such as system modernization, a large-scale migration, or an ERP or billing platform implementation, and turning messy or incomplete inputs into a concrete plan with owners and dates; you're pulled into problems before they're scoped and you're as useful advising a controller on process design as an engineering lead on sequencing

 - Working understanding of data lifecycle and analytics tooling, and real experience running change management for business systems, not just launching them

 - Influence without authority and a bias toward closure. You have no direct reports, so you work through credibility and clear reasoning, knowing when to push and when to escalate; you chase ambiguous items to a decision, will reopen the uncomfortable question a week before launch, and communicate clearly with Director/VP+ stakeholders, including when the news is bad




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Hands-on experience working in enterprise billing, ERP, and revenue systems such as NetSuite, Stripe, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how orders, invoices, and revenue data flow between them

 - Experience supporting an IPO readiness or first-year SOX program, including standing up ITGCs from scratch

 - CISA, CIA, or equivalent certification, or equivalent time embedded on an IT audit team

 - Experience building internal tooling or agents on a workspace platform rather than only configuring vendor systems

jobs.description:
Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Developer to join our team, focusing on Multi/Single Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and cultivating relationships with professional intermediaries and clients, driving business growth, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional service. The position is based in Luxembourg and you will report to the Head of Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries.

Your next challenge:

• Contribute to the growth strategy and to the development of the value proposition of the bank
• Conduct research to identify business opportunities with new customers
• Develop a growth strategy, foster and build both long-term and trustworthy customer relationships with professional intermediaries, including law firms, fiduciaries, and family offices (B2B and B2C)
• Maintain an extensive knowledge of the current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate possible commercial opportunities for the customers
• Collaborate across business lines to help you develop new business leads
• Attend and coordinate events (seminars, conferences)
• Make use of the internal CRM to keep track on your business development activities

Your skills:

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in a front function within the banking or financial services sector
• A strong international network of MFO/SFO & Professional Intermediaries
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance

• Excellent interpersonal skills, an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to build sustainable relationships
• Proven negotiation skills and the ability to close deals
• A high level of integrity and ethics
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance.

• Fluent in English and French, any other language is seen as an advantage (for example : German, Italian)

jobs.title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Inbound Strategy, Long Term Network Planning (m/f)
jobs.description:
Sr. Program Manager, Inbound Strategy, Long Term Network Planning
Job ID: 10498640 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Amazon's Inbound Long Term Planning team owns the topology framework that decides what the EU inbound network looks like in 2–3 years: which node types we build, where we place them, how they interact, and what inventory configuration they unlock. This role owns a critical slice of that framework - taking speed ambitions and placement targets and working backwards into the physical network design across 1DCs, RDCs, and IXDs that makes them achievable. It's the kind of problem where getting the answer right saves hundreds of millions of dollars; getting it wrong means we either over-invest or structurally cap our speed ceiling for years.

You'll work at the intersection of network topology, inventory science, and capital allocation - partnering deeply with Finance, IIPO, AIM, and business teams to determine the optimal long-term node configuration that delivers placement targets per outbound node type and selection cohort. This is a single-threaded role with high ambiguity and regular exposure to senior leadership across SCOT, Operations, and Finance.

Key Job Responsibilities

- Own the long-term inbound topology framework - determine the optimal combination of node types, locations, and capacities that achieves placement targets at minimum total cost.

- Define network configuration per selection cohort - decide velocity demarcations between node types, regional zoning, and upstream storage share. Know when the model breaks and why.
- Build the multi-year inbound build plan - sequence node launches, size them against volume trajectories, and own the placement and inventory commitments that justify the investment.
- Resolve structural trade-offs that don't have clean owners. Frame options, quantify impact, and drive decisions when priorities across teams or geographies conflict.
- Align senior leadership to  single answer. Write the strategy documents that SCOT, Finance, IIPO, and Operations commit to. When priorities diverge, you reconcile.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

General Counsel YIO S.à r.l., Luxembourg

Group General Counsel

Employer: YIO S.à r.l., Luxembourg.

Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, with dotted reporting line to the Board.
Contract: permanent, full-time (40 hours per week). Location: Luxembourg, hybrid, with regular international
travel.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support
• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.
2. Corporate, M&A and governance
• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.
3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation
• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.

jobs.description:

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions : analyse des besoins, conception, installation, configuration, mise en production, maintenance, support et amélioration continue.

Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous interviendrez sur les plateformes de Telkea ICT ainsi que chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous serez un interlocuteur technique privilégié et contribuerez à garantir la qualité des installations, la continuité de service et la satisfaction de nos clients.

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à ;

• Réaliser les nouvelles installations et mises en service de solutions Alcatel OXE/Rainbow ;
• Installer, configurer et maintenir les systèmes de téléphonie et de communications unifiées ;
• Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 et 3 ;
• Traiter quotidiennement les tickets MACD — Move, Add, Change, Delete — ainsi que les incidents et pannes ;
• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes liés à la téléphonie, aux réseaux, à la signalisation SIP et aux flux audio ;
• Assurer l'installation, la configuration et le support des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade ;
• Participer à l'intégration des solutions d'appel malade avec les environnements téléphoniques et les systèmes clients ;
• Évoluer vers une expertise complète des solutions de notification serveur, d'appel malade et de communication destinées aux établissements de soins ;
• Assurer la maintenance préventive et corrective des infrastructures installées ;

• Rédiger les rapports d'intervention, dossiers techniques, procédures et documents d'exploitation ;
• Produire et maintenir les documentations de configuration et les dossiers « as-built » ;
• Assurer une communication technique claire et professionnelle avec les clients ;
• Collaborer avec les fournisseurs, les équipes internes et les autres intervenants des projets ;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes, procédures et outils internes ;
• Développer régulièrement vos compétences techniques ;
• Respecter les exigences de qualité, de confidentialité et de service propres à la clientèle de Telkea ICT.

Profil recherché

Vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans un rôle similaire, dans le domaine des télécommunications, des communications unifiées, des réseaux ou des systèmes d'appel malade.

Vous avez une large culture technique et êtes capable d'intervenir sur des solutions dans leur ensemble, depuis l'installation et la configuration jusqu'au dépannage avancé et au support client.

Une expérience ou des connaissances dans les domaines suivants sont particulièrement appréciées:

• Solutions de téléphonie Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise ;

• Réseaux IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;

• Supervision, ticketing et outils de diagnostic réseau.

Compétences:

• Bonne maîtrise de la téléphonie IP et du protocole SIP ;
• Solides bases en réseaux TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS ;
• Solides bases systèmes Windows, Linux et virtualisation ;
• Capacité à analyser des traces et captures réseau, notamment à l'aide de Wireshark ;
• Expérience en installation, configuration et dépannage de systèmes complexes ;
• La connaissance des environnements DECT et des solutions de mobilité Rainbow constitue un atout ;
• La connaissance des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade constitue un atout ;
• Capacité à comprendre les flux d'alerte, de notification, d'acquittement et d'escalade ;
• Aptitude à rédiger des documents techniques clairs et structurés ;
• Sensibilité aux aspects de sécurité, de disponibilité et de continuité de service ;
• La connaissance d'outils de supervision et de gestion des tickets est appréciée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.

• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

A propos de Telkea Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, Telkea Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et
les Institutions européennes.

Telkea Group (Telkea ICT, Telkea Security, Telkea Telecom et Telkea Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.

Nous accompagnons les administrations, les grandes entreprises et les PME avec la même vision claire : se poser en partenaire fiable, flexible et innovant.

Vous possédez les qualités requises ci-dessus ? Veuillez s'il vous plaît envoyer votre lettre de motivation et votre curriculum vitae (en français ou en anglais) à l'adresse : jobs@telkea.com en indiquant « Candidature au poste d'Expert en Communications Unifiées (H/F) ».

Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a (Senior) Manager, International Markets, to join our International Markets team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

Be part of the team that shapes Delivery Hero’s strategy across our markets worldwide. In the International Markets Team, you’ll contribute to high-impact projects that drive value, support profitability, and unlock growth opportunities on a global scale. Working closely with regional and central leadership, your work will directly influence how we prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and execute strategies that keep us ahead.

Within the International Markets team at Delivery Hero, we:

- Drive Delivery Hero strategy and cascade it to our 70+ markets while ensuring local insights and priorities are taken onboard into the global strategy
- Support P&L and portfolio management actions, both at global and regional levels, and ensure alignment between strategy and P&L
- Prioritize and execute value creation and performance improvement initiatives supporting our regional / local teams with a consultative yet hands-on approach
- Are the key point of contact between the headquarters and our regional and local management entities

In this role, you will:

- Work alongside our C-level and extended global management team at our corporate HQs in Berlin to define strategy and ensure quality of execution at global as well as regional level
- Collaborate with stakeholders across all levels of seniority at the corporate HQ, within the regional team, and in local markets on initiatives to improve operational and financial performance
- Take ownership to source and distribute best practices where needed from Delivery Hero’s operations across 70+ countries, and drive their implementation
- Translate data into meaningful insights, package and present recommendations on critical topics to key decision-makers at Delivery Hero

Qualifications

- You have gained at least 6 years of professional experience (excluding internships and traineeships) in management consulting, investment banking, and/or a business development/strategy function in a fast-paced tech company. At least 2 years of this experience must have been at a top-tier global management consulting firm
- You have a high degree of comfort modelling out complex business and financial scenarios and leveraging data as well as situational judgment to make recommendations and decisions
- You have excellent communication skills (our business language is primarily English) and have a clear track record of working with and influencing, C-level executives
- You are able to build collaborative and trusting relationships with stakeholders across all seniority levels, coming from culturally and functionally diverse backgrounds
- You bring ownership mentality and readiness to roll up your sleeves and be hands-on to get things done

Nice to have:

- International work experience
- Technical skills, especially in SQL

- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

jobs.employer: Personal Spezial Personalservice & Vermittlung Hansjürgen Mathiak
jobs.description:
🌞 OTA (w/m/d) für Temporäreinsätze in Schweizer Spitälern & Kliniken gesucht! 🌞

Ein neues Kapitel für Deine Karriere: Erlebe Freiheit und Top-Vergütung im Schweizer OP!

Du liebst Deinen Beruf als OTA – die Präzision im Saal, das Adrenalin, die Teamarbeit. Aber spürst Du auch, dass starre Schichtmodelle, Dauerstress und starre Strukturen Deine Leidenschaft ausbremsen? Dass Deine Flexibilität viel zu wenig wertgeschätzt wird?

Es ist Zeit für ein spürbares Aufatmen. Zeit für echte Selbstbestimmung. Zeit für den Temporäreinsatz in der Schweiz.

Für renommierte Spitäler und Kliniken (von Universitätskliniken bis hin zu spezialisierten Privatkliniken) in der wunderschönen Deutschschweiz suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung:

Mehrere Operationstechnische Assistentinnen / Assistenten (OTA) für temporäre Einsätze / Vertretungen (m/w/d)

Wie fühlt sich Deine Zukunft an? Stell Dir vor...

- Du bestimmst Deinen Rhythmus: Ob wochenweise, monatsweise oder in festen Blockeinsätzen – Du entscheidest, wann und wie lange Du arbeitest. Plane Deine Auszeiten flexibel zwischen den Einsätzen.
- Du blickst auf Dein Bankkonto und lächelst: Attraktive Schweizer Stunden- bzw. Tagessätze, die Deine Expertise und Einsatzbereitschaft endlich so entlohnen, wie Du es verdienst.
- Fokus auf das Wesentliche: Du konzentrierst Dich voll auf das Instrumentieren, Springertätigkeiten und die OP-Organisation – ohne bürokratischen Leerlauf.
- Respekt auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest in hochmodernen Sälen mit neuester Medizintechnik. Wertschätzung und professioneller Teamgeist sind hier Standard.
- Arbeiten, wo andere Urlaub machen: Nach Feierabend bist Du in wenigen Minuten am See oder in den Bergen. Erlebe Schweizer Lebensqualität während Deiner Einsatzzeit.

Was Du im Gepäck hast:

- Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als OTA oder als Pflegefachkraft mit OP-Fachweiterbildung.
- Bereitschaft für flexible, temporäre Einsätze in verschiedenen Fachdisziplinen.
- Qualitätsbewusstsein, Anpassungsfähigkeit und Freude am Arbeiten in wechselnden OP-Teams.
- Den Wunsch nach Veränderung – wir unterstützen Dich bei der administrativen Abwicklung (inkl. SRK-Anerkennung, Bewilligungen & Logistik).

Warum mit uns? Weil wir Deine Brücke sind.

Wir sind keine anonyme Plattform. Seit 25 Jahren vermitteln wir erfolgreich Fachpersonal – davon seit 11 Jahren mit exklusivem Fokus auf Schweizer Kliniken. Wir begleiten Dich lückenlos und für Dich komplett kostenfrei:

- Rundum-Sorglos-Paket: Wir kümmern uns um den gesamten Papierkram, Verträge und Unterkünfte vor Ort.
- Perfektes Matching: Wir finden genau die Einsätze und Kliniken, die zu Deinem Profil und Deinen Wunschterminen passen.
- Persönliche Betreuung: Vor, während und nach Deinem Einsatz sind wir immer direkt an Deiner Seite.

Spürst Du dieses Kribbeln?

Das ist das Gefühl von Freiheit und Flexibilität. Lass uns in einem kurzen, vertraulichen Gespräch klären, welche Einsatzmodelle und Regionen am besten zu Deinen Plänen passen. Du musst heute nichts entscheiden!

Mach den ersten Schritt – ganz ohne aufwendigen Lebenslauf!

Klicke einfach auf den Button, hinterlasse uns Deine Kontaktdaten und wir rufen Dich für ein entspanntes Kennenlernen an.

👉 Jetzt in 60 Sekunden Kontakt aufnehmen!

E-Mail: bewerbung@pflege-job-schweiz.ch

Tel.: +49 170 311 41 39

jobs.description:
**Dein Erzieher:in-Job beim ASB Bremen... **

Der ASB Bremen ist mit rund 20.000 Mitgliedern und 1.700 haupt- und ehrenamtlichen Mitarbeiter:innen der größte Hilfs- und Wohlfahrtsverband in Bremen. Seit 35 Jahren sind wir zudem ein bedeutender Akteur im Bereich der institutionellen Kinder- und Jugendhilfe in Bremen. An rund sechszig Bremer Grundschulen tragen wir als ASB Kinder- und Jugendhilfe gGmbH mit unserem Team aus ca. 350 Erzieher:innen und pädagogischen Fachkräften die Verantwortung für Betreuungsangebote von Grundschulkindern im Rahmen der Verlässlichen Grundschule sowie im offenen und gebundenen Ganztag. Gemeinsam sind wir stark!

Wir suchenab sofort eine: Erzieher:in / pädagogische Fachkraftan derGrundschule in der Vahr in Teilzeit mit 25,0 bis35,0 Wochenstunden.

Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

- Die liebevolle Betreuung und Unterstützung der Schüler:innen während des Unterrichts und der Pausen
- Die umsichtige Planung und Durchführung von pädagogischen Angeboten und Projekten
- Die professionelle Förderung der individuellen Entwicklung und Sozialkompetenz der Kinder
- Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Lehrkräften und Eltern zur bestmöglichen Unterstützung der Schüler:innen
- Die Betreuung in der Mensa

Wir bieten dir:

- Eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem äußerst engagierten Team
- Eine herzliche und kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre
- Flache Hierarchien und schnelle Arbeitsabläufe
- 30 Tage Jahresurlaub (in den Ferien) + bezahlte Freistellung in den Bremer Schulferien
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Betriebliche Sozialberatung
- Jahressonderzahlung
- Firmenfitnessprogramm über EGYM Wellpass
- Teilnahme an Mitarbeiterevents
- Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Vergünstigter Tarif bei der Autoversicherung
- Arbeitgeberzuschuss zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen

Was du mitbringen solltest:

- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannte:rErzieher:in, Heilerziehungspfleger:innen, Ergotherapeut:in, ein Bachlor-StudiumKindheitspädagogikoderMaster of Educationoder eine vergleichbare pädagogische Qualifikation
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern im Grundschulalter
- Einfühlungsvermögen, Geduld und Teamfähigkeit
- Engagement und Kreativität bei der Gestaltung von pädagogischen Angeboten
- Die Fähigkeit zur Reflexion der eigenen pädagogischen Arbeit und zur Zusammenarbeit im Team
- Die Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme an Klassenfahrten, Ausflügen, Schulkonferenzen, Elternabenden, Schulveranstaltungen und Ähnlichem
- Den Nachweis über den Masernschutz (Zwei Masernschutzimpfungen oder Masernimmunität durch Blutbildbestimmung)

Vergütung/Befristung:

- Bei Vorliegen der staatlichen Anerkennung als Erzieher:in erfolgt die Vergütung in Anlehnung an den TV-L S in Entgeltgruppe S8a.
- Bei anderen pädagogischen Qualifikationen erfolgt die Vergütung in der Regel in Anlehnung an den TV-L S in Entgeltgruppe S4.

jobs.title: Sozialarbeiter/-in, Sozialpädagogin/Sozialpädagoge (w/m/d) (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest junge Menschen und Familien dabei unterstützen, ihren eigenen Weg zu finden und neue Perspektiven zu entwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns dich kennenzulernen.

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte SozialarbeiterInnen und Sozialpädagoginnen/ Sozialpädagogen (w/m/d) oder Fachkräfte mit vergleichbarer akademischer Qualifikation in Vollzeit zur Verstärkung unseres Teams der Flexiblen Jugendhilfe Landkreis München.

Die Stelle ist unbefristet und wird nach den **AVR der Diakonie Bayern [Entgeltgruppe 10**] vergütet.

In unserem Team der ambulanten Erziehungshilfen begleiten wir im Landkreis München Kinder, Jugendliche und Familien in ganz unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen und Herausforderungen des Alltags. Wir beraten und unterstützen Eltern bei Erziehungs- und Alltagsproblemen, stärken die elterliche Kompetenz und fördern die altersgemäße soziale Entwicklung junger Menschen. Die komplexen Themen werden in Form von Hausbesuchen, Begleitung zu Terminen und Gruppenangeboten bearbeitet.

Darüber hinaus begleiten wir junge Menschen ab dem vollendeten 16. Lebensjahr im Rahmen unserer Flexiblen Betreuten Wohnformen auf ihrem Weg in ein selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Leben. Hier geht es darum, junge Menschen individuell zu unterstützen, ihnen Sicherheit und Orientierung zu geben und sie Schritt für Schritt in ihrer Verselbstständigung zu fördern.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Dich erwartet ein abwechslungsreiches und vielseitiges Arbeitsfeld, in dem du eigenverantwortlich arbeiten und gleichzeitig auf ein engagiertes Team zählen kannst.

Du hast die Möglichkeit, deine fachlichen Kompetenzen und persönlichen Stärken einzubringen und gemeinsam mit den jungen Menschen und Familien an individuellen Lösungen zu arbeiten.

Du passt zu uns, wenn du …

- Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern, Jugendlichen, jungen Erwachsenen und Familien hast,
- eine wertschätzende und ressourcenorientierte Haltung mitbringst,
- auch in herausfordernden Situationen den Überblick behältst,
- gerne eigenverantwortlich und gleichzeitig im Team arbeitest,
- Veränderungsprozesse begleiten und mitgestalten möchtest,
- dich für die Lebenswelten und individuellen Geschichten junger Menschen interessierst und
- Lust hast, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln und neue Ideen einzubringen.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Provider Reimbursement (m/f/d) - Oracle Health (Product Owner)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Product Manager to drive the design and delivery of Oracle's next-generation provider reimbursement solution for the German healthcare market. In this role, you will serve as the product and domain expert responsible for translating complex hospital reimbursement requirements into scalable software capabilities. Working closely with hospitals, healthcare organizations, regulatory bodies, customers, and internal stakeholders, you will define the functional requirements that guide the development of our next-generation reimbursement platform. A key focus of this role is enabling engineering teams to successfully deliver innovative solutions that support German inpatient reimbursement processes. You will gather and analyze customer requirements, document business workflows, define product specifications, and collaborate with engineering throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure solutions meet both market and regulatory expectations. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in German inpatient reimbursement, including G-DRG-based payment methodologies, hospital billing, and revenue cycle processes. They will continuously monitor changes in healthcare regulations and reimbursement policies, assess their impact on product functionality, and drive the implementation of required enhancements. This position offers the opportunity to shape the future of provider reimbursement technology in Germany by building modern, compliant, and customer-centric solutions that help healthcare organizations optimize reimbursement outcomes and operational efficiency.

We expressly encourage disabled candidates to apply for this position. Please therefore feel free to voluntarily inform us in your application about any severe disability (degree of disability of at least 50%) or any equal status (degree of disability of at least 30% together with official decision on equality) in accordance with the German SGB IX.

jobs.title: Director of Data Center Operations (Germany) (m/f/d) (Industrietechnologe/-technologin - Datentechnik)
jobs.description:
As a Director of German Data Centre Operations, you will be responsible for:

• Providing leadership, direction and strategy across our German territory.

• Building and leading a new DCO organization in Germany.

• Working with geographically distributed teams and contributing to the success of his/her organization and other related teams.

• Coaching and mentoring managers and individual contributors across the organization.

• Growing the team by recruiting and retaining top talent.

• Delivering large-scale projects on-time with high quality.

• Collaborating and working effectively with various teams across the organization at both a technical level and a business level.

• Ensuring all sites are delivered to a standardized, high-quality bar, and this quality is sustained, day on day, week on week, year on year.

• Holding others to account as needed to ensure we meet our quality & delivery goals.

• Defining and contributing to global objectives to move the organization forwards.

As a Director of German Data Centre Operations, you will lead the region and be responsible for the overall availability of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure. You should be able to dive deep into any part of the stack and higher-level system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. You should have a demonstrated track record working in the industry, already having worked at hyperscale in previous positions. You should be fully versed in Data Centre build, live operations management, change control and be familiar with LEAN and 5S. Detailed Description and Job Requirements Working with world-class global teams to implement and support cutting-edge Oracle technology in Cloud Data Centres requires an experienced manager with a proven ability to lead from the front who can thrive in a complex matrix environment. To maximize the quality of delivery and reliability of our sites you will:

• Work across multiple LOB effectively, negotiating and bringing together stakeholders & teams to ensure success for Oracle.

• Negotiating and working with local vendors to deliver a strategy to drive performance and meet quality expectations. This encompasses LV cabling vendors through to Colocation partners.

• Work closely with Human Resources within the regions to ensure the best possible relationship and care for your Oracle employees.

• Focus and prioritize appropriately on what is most important to Oracle at any given time as priorities can shift quickly.

• Drive scalability practices to ensure efficiencies across your organization and space. Project work will also be a crucial part of the engagement, you will also:

• Lead the implementation of multi-functional projects and/or systems.

• Manage scope, expectations, implementation approach, deliverables and acceptance testing criteria, whilst appropriately managing risk.

• Driving the delivery of improvements. Interacting across functional areas to ensure objectives are met.

• Driving the development of short, medium, and long-term plans and regularly interacting across functional areas with executives to achieve strategic objectives.

• Demonstrate a track record of influencing thinking and gaining acceptance of others in sensitive situations.

• Be proactive at all times, resolving issues before they become critical.

• Work independently without escalation or supervision.

• Manage upwards effectively to VP level, with succinct, clear communication, and a solution-first approach.

• Manage individual contributors where you do not have direct authority over them.

• Resolve conflicts without escalation, by negotiation, understanding and mediating as necessary.

• Lead by example at all times.

• Be fully versed in managing risk (both project delivery and infrastructure management).

• Be able to devise plans, and strategies, bringing others on the journey with you.

• Be continuously learning about new technology advantages related to Data Centres (e.g. power density, cooling, cabling, critical load management) a SME in at least two areas. You should be able to: Candidate can expect:

• A stable environment with low turnover and great opportunities to grow.

• A merit-based organization.

• An opportunity to contribute to a well-recognized, revenue-producing Oracle product that has thousands of customers as well as be involved in cutting-edge technology

• Challenging and diverse projects.

• Competitive salary and benefits. What you need to know to be successful in this role:

für das Projekt im Rahmen der Ganztagsförderung an der Pestalozzigrundschule suchen wir ab sofort eine Koordinierende Pädagogische Fachkraft in Vollzeit.

Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden/Woche

Heilpädagogium Schillerhain

Das sind wir

Mit Herz und Engagement stehen wir Kindern, Jugendlichen und Familien zur Seite. Dafür leiten wir mehrere stationäre Wohngruppen, Tagesgruppen sowie eine Fünf-Tage-Gruppe. Unsere ambulanten Dienste und die Multisystemische Therapie (MST) unterstützen Familien im eigenen Zuhause. Die Beratungsstelle für Eltern, Kinder und Jugendliche bietet ebenfalls eine wichtige Anlaufstelle. Mit unseren Sozialpädagogischen Pflegestellen schaffen wir einen weiteren sicheren Rahmen für Kinder. Eine gute Schulbildung stellen wir in der Herman-Nohl-Schule mit dem Förderschwerpunkt sozial-emotionale Entwicklung sicher.

Für das Schuljahr werden wir ein Projekt an einer Grundschule in Mainz anbieten, welches im Rahmen des Ganztagsförderungsgesetzes Kindern der 1. Klasse eine Ganztagsbetreuung und Förderung bietet. Eingruppierung erfolgt nach S8B/TV-L.

Wenn Sie junge Menschen dabei begleiten möchten, ihren Weg zu finden, werden Sie Teil unseres Teams.
Denn wir suchen Verstärkung – wir suchen Sie!

Damit Sie immer „Stark“ bleiben, sind wir Partner des Firmenfitness-Netzwerks EGYM Wellpass und unterstützen unsere Mitarbeiter/innen mit einer vergünstigten Mitgliedschaft in über 16.000 Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen.

So passen Sie perfekt zu uns

Was Sie mitbringen

- eine Ausbildung zum Erzieher (m/w/d) oder Heilerziehungspfleger (m/w/d)
- Erfahrung in der Koordination eines Teams
- selbständige Arbeitsweise
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Freude beim Aufbau eines neuen Projekts
- Identifikation mit den christlichen Grundwerten unserer Stiftung
- ein humorvolles und aufgeschlossenes Wesen und Spaß an der Arbeit mit Kindern

Das macht Ihnen Spaß

Ihre Aufgaben

- Koordination eines Teams vor Ort

- Pädagogische Betreuung und Förderung von Grundschulkindern am Nachmittag und in einem Teil der Ferien
- Gestaltung des Angebots nach den Projektvorgaben

Die 1409 gegründete Universität Leipzig gehört zu den großen, forschungsstarken und medizinführenden Universitäten in Deutschland. - Verhandlungsgeschick und Moderationskompetenz
- Serviceorientierung, Kreativität und Eigeninitiative

We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Student Assistant (WHB) (f/m/x) – Audiovisual Science Communication

Biomedizinische Informatik TV-L: 19 h/week (49,35%) limited for 1 year according to WissZeitVG (Third-party funded project)
Compensation is €15,11 per hour of weekly employment
TV-L: 19 h/week (49,35%) limited for 1 year according to WissZeitVG (Third-party funded project)
Compensation is €15,11 per hour of weekly employment
Your tasks

You’ll help us create engaging audiovisual content that makes complex scientific and/or technical topics accessible — whether for specialist audiences like clinicians and researchers, or for the general public. This includes:
• Designing and producing short explainer videos, animations, and visual storytelling pieces
• Supporting the development of educational materials for workshops and online platforms
• Supporting the literature review behind each piece —
helping gather, organise, and distil source material
together with the researchers, as input for the content
• Collaborating closely with Data Stewards and Developers to translate technical content into compelling visuals
Your profile

• Enrolment in a relevant degree programme (Media Design, Communication Design, UX/UI, Motion Design, Digital Film, or similar), with a completed Bachelor’s degree
• Hands-on skills in video editing, motion graphics, and animation — whichever software you work in
• A genuine curiosity about science and/or informatics — no prior biomedical knowledge required, just an open mind
• Strong visual communication instincts and an eye for clean, purposeful design
• Reliable, self-directed work style and good communication skills, ideally with knowledge of German / English
Have we piqued your interest? If so, please send us your detailed resume and a brief portfolio of your work.
Our offer

• Everything but ordinary: You can expect a secure job in a challenging, innovative environment – including company pension schemes and regular working hours without business trips.
• Work-life balance: Whether full-time or part-time, with or without children – with numerous support options, we will find the right path together.
• Team spirit in R(h)ine culture: You will be warmly welcomed by an interdisciplinary team that values mutual respect and helpfulness.
• Strong perspectives: We offer extensive training opportunities – so you can continuously grow and set new goals.
  Your future with us

We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.
Your future in detail

At the Institute for Biomedical Informatics at the University of Cologne we combine biomedicine and informatics to provide support for researchers, patients, and the general public. We believe science doesn’t just need to be done — it needs to be understood. That’s where you come in.

- Du stellst den stabilen und sicheren Betrieb unserer LAN- und WLAN-Infrastruktur sowie angeschlossener Systeme wie Zutritts- und Zeiterfassung, Telefonie und Druck-/Internetservices sicher.

- Du entwickelst Konzepte für den Ausbau und die Optimierung unserer Netzwerk- und Kommunikationsinfrastruktur.
- Du arbeitest eng mit IT, Produktion und weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen und bist Teil eines Teams, das die Infrastruktur von KWS kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt.

Dein Profil – das bringst du mit:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d), idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Systemintegration, Anwendungsentwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation.
- Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Infrastruktur, Netzwerke oder Systemadministration ist von Vorteil.
- Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft-Betriebssystemen; Erfahrungen mit Cisco-Komponenten sind ein Plus.

- Bereitschaft zur Rufbereitschaft und Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands (bis zu 25 %).

Mit uns beginnst du deine Zukunft … Was wir dir zum Wachstum anbieten:

- Eine unbefristete Position mit eigenem Verantwortungsbereich und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
- Spannende IT-Infrastruktur- und Netzwerkprojekte in einem internationalen Umfeld.
- Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Wegen, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und einer offenen Unternehmenskultur.

Du möchtest nicht nur programmieren, sondern ein neues Softwareprodukt von Anfang an mit aufbauen und technisch prägen?

Ergolabs entwickelt ein eigenständiges MedTech-Produkt mit Startup-Spirit: ein digitales Webportal für medizintechnische Labore, Praxen und ihre Partner.

Wir verbinden mehr als 20 Jahre Erfahrung in Arbeitswissenschaft, Human Factors und Softwareentwicklung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Das Produkt entsteht in enger Zusammenarbeit am Standort Wuppertal im Bergischen Land.
Mobiles Arbeiten ist möglich, regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort gehört jedoch dazu.
Du solltest deshalb in erreichbarer Nähe wohnen oder bereit sein, regelmäßig nach Wuppertal zu kommen.

Das Besondere: Greenfield-Entwicklung mit praxiserprobter Produktgrundlage

Ein gewachsenes PHP-Portal mit den wesentlichen Funktionen und Arbeitsabläufen wird bereits seit rund fünf Jahren produktiv eingesetzt. Es zeigt, was im Arbeitsalltag funktioniert.

Das bestehende System dient als fachliche und funktionale Referenz. Die neue Anwendung wird als eigenständige Lösung mit einer modernen, modularen TypeScript-Architektur entwickelt. Ihre fachliche Grundlage ist weitgehend vorbereitet: Geschäftsmodell, Prozesse, Rollen, Datenobjekte, Rechte und Schnittstellen.

Geplanter Stack

- TypeScript-Monorepo mit Next.js, React und NestJS
- PostgreSQL mit typsicherer Datenzugriffsschicht
- modularer Monolith mit Docker Compose, Nginx und Ubuntu Server
- bewusst schlanke Architektur und Infrastruktur für ein kleines, leistungsfähiges Team

Deine Aufgabe

Du entwickelst zusammenhängende Funktionen vom Datenmodell über die Geschäftslogik bis zur Benutzeroberfläche, bindest externe Systeme an und wirkst an Tests, Dokumentation und stabilem Betrieb mit.

Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zunehmend technische Verantwortung für das Produkt.

Das bringst du mit

- ein laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines verwandten Fachgebietes beziehungsweise eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung
- praktische Erfahrung mit JavaScript oder TypeScript, gern aus eigenen Projekten
- erste Kenntnisse in React mit Next.js oder Node.js mit NestJS
- Grundlagen in relationalen Datenbanken und Schnittstellen
- Eigeninitiative, strukturiertes Denken und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Du musst noch kein fertiger Softwarearchitekt sein und auch die Medizintechnik noch nicht kennen.

Das erwartet dich

- eine neue Codebasis mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
- ein bereits praktisch erprobtes Produktkonzept
- direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Product Owner und Systemarchitekten
- Unterstützung und Code-Reviews durch zwei erfahrene Softwareentwickler
- flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten in Verbindung mit regelmäßiger Zusammenarbeit in Wuppertal
- eine langfristige Entwicklungsperspektive mit wachsender Verantwortung

Je nach Studienstand und Erfahrung ist der Einstieg als Werkstudent oder direkt in Festanstellung möglich.

Ein langes Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich.

Ergolabs GmbH

Unser Auftraggeber ist einer der größten Softwarehersteller Europas und steht für qualitativ hochwertige Software und IT-Dienstleistung.

Wir begleiten Dich im gesamten Bewerbungsprozess und informieren Dich detailliert über unseren Auftraggeber: 100% persönlich, professionell und vertrauensvoll. Dieser Job ist im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit Option auf Übernahme bei unserem Auftraggeber zu besetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du unterstützt und berätst Entwicklungsteams bei der Realisierung sicherer Cloud-Native-Anwendungen und verankerst Security-Anforderungen in modernen Softwarearchitekturen.
- Du analysierst und priorisierst Sicherheitslücken, begleitest Penetrationstests sowie Bedrohungs- und Risikoanalysen und entwickelst daraus geeignete Maßnahmen.
- Du stellst die konsequente Umsetzung aktueller Security-Anforderungen und Governance-Vorgaben innerhalb der Entwicklungsprozesse sicher.
- Du definierst und überwachst Security-Metriken, um identifizierte Schwachstellen nachhaltig und innerhalb der vorgesehenen Fristen zu beheben.
- Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung des Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) aktiv mit und stärkst Security über den gesamten Entwicklungsprozess hinweg.

Dein Profil

- Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Du hast Erfahrung in Application Security, DevSecOps oder Secure SDLC und hast Security-Prozesse bereits erfolgreich in der Praxis umgesetzt.
- Du bringst Erfahrung im Bereich CI/CD-Security sowie bei der Einbindung automatisierter Security-Checks und Quality Gates mit.
- Du bist mit SAST- und SCA-Tools vertraut und wirkst bei der Bewertung und Behebung von Sicherheitsbefunden mit.
- Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis von Webservices, APIs sowie gängigen Schwachstellen und Angriffsmodellen verteilter Systeme.
- Du gehst bei der Risikoanalyse strukturiert vor, priorisierst Maßnahmen nachvollziehbar und vermittelst komplexe Sachverhalte sicher zwischen Engineering und Management.
- Du arbeitest selbstständig, treibst Themen proaktiv voran und sorgst auch in anspruchsvollen Projekten für Struktur und Ergebnisse.

jobs.title: The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as Junior Researcher / Pr (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as

Junior Researcher / PreDoc (Kiel or Berlin)

We are looking for up to two highly motivated Junior Researchers / PreDocs to join our dynamic research team at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy. The positions are almost full-time (75-90 percent). One position should be based in Kiel and another one optional in Kiel or in our Research Hub in Berlin. Both positions are linked to the research group by Prof. Christoph Trebesch and his ERC project on Great Power Finance.

The two positions have the following focus, respectively:

1. Digital chokepoints: geopolitical risk and telecom networks
2. International capital flows: great powers and cross-border investments across 200 years

Your Role

Your main role will be to contribute to cutting-edge research on one or two of the projects. The work will involve extensive data collection and rigorous empirical analysis using historical and contemporary sources. A particular focus of these roles will be archival research and the construction of novel datasets from historical records and documents related to telecommunications, computer science, financial assets and international capital flows.

As part of Christoph Trebesch’s research group, you will work closely with senior researchers on high-impact projects in macroeconomics, economic history, and political economy. The positions offer an excellent opportunity to gain advanced research experience, develop strong empirical skills, and contribute to internationally visible academic work.

Your Profile

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

- ·         Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in economics (completed or close to completion) with very good grades.
- ·         Strong quantitative and empirical skills and experience, particularly:
- For position (1): experience with data on telecommunication and computer science
- For position (2): experience with data on financial assets and/or international capital flows, ideally also historical financial data
- ·         Experience with advanced AI tools and statistical software such as Stata, R, and/or Python.
- ·         Interest in historical research and archival work.
- ·         Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.
- ·         Excellent analytical and organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality research.
- The working language is English; excellent English skills are therefore required. Some knowledge of German would be useful, but is not important.

We are offering

The planned contract period is 10 months (starting in the fall of 2026). The salary will be based on the German public sector pay scale at grade EG 12 or 13 TV L. The position is part-time between 75-90%.

The Kiel Institute for the World Economy values diversity. We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age or sexual orientation. The Kiel Institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/equal-opportunity/) . We promote the professional opportunities of women and strongly encourage them to apply. Women with equivalent qualifications, competence and expertise will be given preference. We are committed to employing persons with recognized disabilities and will therefore give them preference over persons without disabilities if they are equally qualified.

In order to be eligible for this position you have to hold EU citizenship or need to be able to provide a work permit that is valid throughout the time of your contract.

Please submit your application online (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/job-vacancies/junior-researcher-/-predoc-kiel-or-berlin/) using ID-No. “PreDoc_2026”. Please include (i) a letter of interest, (ii) your CV, (iii) one or two work samples (e.g. Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis), (iv) university transcripts, as well as (if applicable) (v) proofs of relevant work experience. Ideally submit just one PDF, including “PreDoc” and your family name as file name. The deadline for applications is September 7, 2026 Application photos should not be included.

For additional information, please contact Prof. Christoph Trebesch (christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de (https://mailto:christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de) ).

jobs.title: Nanny / Kinderbetreuerin (m/w/d) f. Mailand gesucht A26/2582 Mai (Kinderbetreuer/in)
jobs.description:
Mailand

Gesucht wird für den Privathaushalt einer Unternehmerfamilie in Mailand eine liebenswerte, zuverlässige **Rota-Nanny / Kinderfrau (m/w/d)** zur Betreuung von drei Kindern im Alter von 3, 4 und 9 Jahren (im 14 Tage frei / 14 Tage arbeiten- Rhythmus). Im Mittelpunkt der Position steht die liebevolle und verantwortungsbewusste Begleitung der Kinder durch ihren abwechslungsreichen Alltag. Dazu gehören die Betreuung, die Begleitung zu Freizeitaktivitäten sowie die Gestaltung gemeinsamer Aktivitäten – insbesondere im Freien. Die Familie reist regelmäßig und verbringt unter anderem Zeit in ihrem Feriendomizil in St. Moritz sowie im Sommerhaus in Österreich. Reisebereitschaft und Freude an einem internationalen Familienumfeld sind daher wichtige Voraussetzungen. Neben der Kinderbetreuung gehören leichte Tätigkeiten im Haushalt sowie eine gelegentliche, kindgerechte Zubereitung von Mahlzeiten zum Aufgabenbereich. Die gesuchte Fachkraft arbeitet dabei in einem bereits gut organisierten Privathaushalt mit einer weiteren Rota-Nanny, einem Haushälter, einem Koch und einer Reinigungskraft. Gesucht wird eine Persönlichkeit, die warmherzig, diskret, verantwortungsbewusst und flexibel ist und Freude daran hat, Teil eines anspruchsvollen familiären Umfelds zu sein. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erwünscht; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Vorausgesetzt werden fundierte und nachweisbare Berufserfahrung in der Betreuung mehrerer Kinder, idealerweise in einem vergleichbaren gehobenen Privathaushalt; eine ca. 35 m² große separate Unterkunft wird gestellt. Die Position ist nach Absprache zu besetzen und bietet eine überdurchschnittlich attraktive Vergütung. Geboten wird ein langfristiges, professionelles Arbeitsumfeld mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität, Diskretion und persönlicher Betreuung.

Referenz-Nr.: A26/2582 Mai

jobs.description:
Empregado de Mesa

Descrição da empresa

You create experiences for our guests. As an employer, we create experiences for you. How? At The Cloud One, every day is unique. Never same-same, always thrillingly different. With us, you have the freedom to be who you are – or who you want to be. Because here, individuality is what matters. With equal – and exciting – opportunities for all. We believe in an inclusive culture that puts people like you at the heart of what we do, because we know that you’re the ones who make the difference. For us, respect and success go hand in hand. We’re locally rooted: connected to the city, its culture and its people. Are you with us?

Descrição do emprego

Estamos à procura de um(a) Empregado(a) de Mesa com paixão pelo serviço, atenção ao detalhe e vontade de proporcionar experiências memoráveis aos nossos clientes. A pessoa selecionada irá integrar uma equipa dinâmica e colaborativa numa unidade hoteleira em Lisboa, onde o foco está na hospitalidade genuína e no serviço de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Receber e acompanhar os clientes de forma cordial e profissional.
- Apresentar o menu, esclarecer dúvidas e fazer sugestões adequadas.
- Servir refeições e bebidas com eficiência, atenção e simpatia.
- Assegurar que todas as necessidades dos clientes são atendidas durante o serviço.
- Preparar e organizar mesas antes e após o serviço.
- Colaborar com a equipa de sala e cozinha para garantir um serviço fluido.
- Cumprir com os padrões de higiene, segurança e qualidade definidos pela unidade.

Qualificações

Formação e Experiência:

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos em funções semelhantes (preferencialmente em hotelaria ou restauração de luxo).
- Formação na área de hotelaria ou restauração (valorizada).

Competências Técnicas:

- Conhecimento de técnicas de serviço à mesa.
- Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas de POS.
- Conhecimento das normas HACCP.

Competências Pessoais:

- Excelente comunicação e apresentação pessoal.
- Simpatia, proatividade e atenção ao cliente.
- Espírito de equipa e flexibilidade para trabalhar por turnos, fins de semana e feriados.
- Fluência em português e inglês (outras línguas são valorizadas).

Schwerpunkt Mammographie: Eigenverantwortliche und empathische Durchführung von Mammographien auf höchstem technischem Niveau sowie Betreuung der Patientinnen während des gesamten Untersuchungsablaufs.

Persönlichkeit: Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Empathie im Umgang mit Patienten sowie eine zuverlässige, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.

Attraktive Vergütung: Schweizer Gehaltsstandard inklusive hervorragender Sozialleistungen und Vorsorgekonzepte.

Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u odnosu na ostale kandidate, samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Pisane prijave s prilozima dostaviti isključivo na adresu: Centar za odgoj i obrazovanje Tuškanac, Tuškanac 15, 10000 Zagreb, s naznakom: „Natječaj za učitelja - ne otvarati“. jobs.title: Night Audit (Night-Auditor)
jobs.description:
Night Audit

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 80 hotels in 12 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

As the founder and pioneer of the budget design concept, we are successfully expanding in the metropolises of Europe and beyond. Become part of our team and develop Motel One with us.

Job Description

Looking after our guests in a professional manner at the front desk is extremely important at all times – from a warm welcome at check-in until their departure, your job will be to assist our early risers and night owls. Your duties will also include the following:

- Welcoming guests, checking in and out.
- Preparing daily closing balances
- Cash transactions and cashing up
- Processing booking requests
- Preparing and serving Drinks.
- Preparing for breakfast
- General light cleaning of the lobby and public areas.

Qualifications

Whether you are a hotel professional or changing careers – you will fit in here! Because personality and hosting skills are our priority. You will also:

- Have an excellent sense of quality and service, as well as hosting skills and a passion for the hotel industry
- Be open, communicative and confident and have a solid command of English
- Be a team player and willing to provide assistance across departments – we achieve our results together
- Applicants must be able to speak, read, and understand English to effectively communicate in the role.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati/kandidatkinje su izričito suglasni/e da Dom za žrtve obiteljskog nasilja „Utočište Sveti Nikola“, kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka. Tražite li radno mjesto koje omogućava usavršavanje i sudjelovanje u razvoju novih tehnologija?

Naša tvrtka je predani visokotehnološki proizvođač implantanata i medicinskih instrumenata, a radimo na uzbuđujućim projektima u području ortopedije, neurokirurgije, traumatologije te industrijskih sektora.

Ako dijelite našu strast za inovacijama i želite biti dio tima koji sudjeluje u razvoju novih tehnologija, onda ste pravi kandidat za nas!

Naši kupci su renomirane tvrtke diljem svijeta, a mi pružamo priliku da se uključite u sve faze procesa, od koncepta do finalne proizvodnje.

Tražimo obrazovane i kvalitetne pojedince koji su motivirani za osobni razvoj te žele ostvariti uspjeh kroz stručan servis našim klijentima.

  • glodanje

  • postavljanje i sigurno rukovanje proizvodima na strojevima, korištenje steznih naprava,
  • kontrola gotovog proizvoda na stroju pomoću mjernih instrumenata,
  • razumijevanje i poznavanje: upravljanja, stezanja, alata, NUL-točke,
  • korištenje CNC-dokumentacije,
  • kontrola i korekcija alata,
  • zamjena alata na CNC-stroju,
  • osnovno poznavanje G-koda,
  • ispunjavanje radnog naloga i ispitnih protokola,
  • dnevno čišćenje strojeva,
  • prednost višegodišnje radno iskustvo na CNC strojevima,
  • pomoć drugim zaposlenicima koji obavljaju poslove strojne obrade.

- SSS (završena škola strojarskog smjera)

- samostalnost, fleksibilnost

- motiviranost za rad u timu

- odgovoran i profesionalan pristup.

Što nudimo: Rang plaća (bruto) prema znanju i iskustvu:

  1. razred – 1.250 EUR
  2. razred – 1.400 EUR
  3. razred – 1.600 EUR
  4. razred – 1.800 EUR

Ako želite biti dio inovativnog tima koji radi na vrhunskim projektima, pošaljite nam svoj životopis i pridružite se našoj misiji postizanja izvrsnosti u tehnologiji i medicinskim inovacijama.

Vaš životopis s naznakom radnog mjesta molimo vas pošaljite na:

Uvjeti koje moraju ispunjavati prijavljeni kandidati:

- završen studij za ing. medicinske radiologije / prvostupnik radiološke tehnologije

- položen stručni ispit

​Uz prijavu svi kandidati su dužni priložiti:

  • vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu za točno određeno radno mjesto (dostupno na službenoj internetskoj stranici Opće bolnice Šibensko-kninske županije u dijelu „Dokumenti“)
  • životopis
  • dokaz o traženom završenom stupnju obrazovanja (svjedodžba/diploma)
  • uvjerenje o položenom stručnom ispitu (toč. 4.- 19.)
  • posjedovanje važećeg odobrenja za samostalan rad (toč. 1.- 9.)

  • potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radnom stažu – e-radna knjižica (ne stariju od dana objave natječaja)
  • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (toč. 1.- 9.)
  • vjenčani list ili drugi odgovarajući dokaz u slučaju promjene imena i/ili prezimena

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Prijave na natječaj se podnose osobno ili preporučenom pošiljkom u roku od 8 (osam) dana od dana objave na službenoj internetskoj stranici Bolnice na adresu Opća bolnica Šibensko-kninske županije, Stjepana Radića 83, 22 000 Šibenik, s naznakom „za natječaj za ________„. Nepravovremene i nepotpune prijave koje nisu potpisane i ne sadrže sve što su kandidati dužni priložiti neće se razmatrati.

Osobe koje prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br.121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), čl. 48.f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ br.33/92,77/92,27/93,58/93,2/94,76/94,108/95,108/96, 82/01,103/03, 148/13 i 98/19) i čl.9. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema čl. 103.st.1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br.121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), a koji se mogu naći i na poveznici https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema čl. 9. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (“Narodne novine” br. 84/21 i 13/26) dužni su se pozvati na pravo prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze iz čl. 49. Po potrebi, ovisno o broju prijavljenih kandidata, posebno povjerenstvo koje imenuje ravnatelj provesti će se testiranje/razgovore. O načinu provođenja testiranja/razgovora, izvorima za pripremanje kandidata, vremenu testiranja/razgovora, kandidati će biti obaviješteni objavama na službenoj internetskoj stranici Opće bolnice Šibensko-kninske županije (www.bolnica-sibenik.hr).

Svi prijavljeni kandidati bit će obaviješteni o rezultatima natječaja, te su dužni u roku od 15 dana od dana zaprimanja obavijesti o rezultatima natječaja preuzeti svoju dokumentaciju ukoliko je ista u originalu ili ovjerenoj kopiji jer će u suprotnom biti uništena. Primljeni kandidati dužni su bolnici prije početka rada dostaviti originalnu ili ovjerenu svjedodžbu/diplomu, uvjerenje o položenom ispitu, odobrenje za samostalan rad i domovnicu.

Bolnica pridržava pravo poništenja natječaja u cijelosti ili djelomično, bez obrazloženja.

Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13,152/14, 7/17, 68/18 i 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23), Srednja škola Dental centar Marušić, Benkovačka 10 A, raspisuje NATJEČAJ za prijam u radni odnos nastavnik/ca Engleskog jezika – 1 izvršitelj/ica, neodređeno nepuno radno vrijeme 30,5 sati tjedno uz probni rad od šest mjeseci. Opći uvjet za zasnivanje radnog odnosa i posebni uvjeti propisani Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi. Prednost imaju kandidati s više radnog iskustva. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu u kojoj treba navesti osobne podatke kandidata (ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela te adresu elektroničke pošte) potrebno je priložiti:
  • životopis,
  • diplomu odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika osobne iskaznice ili preslika domovnice),
  • uvjerenje o nekažnjavanju, ne starije od tri mjeseca od dana isteka roka za prijavu na natječaj,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, ne starije od tri mjeseca od dana isteka roka za prijavu na natječaj.
Dokumentacija se dostavlja u preslici i ne vraća se kandidatima. Nakon odabira kandidata, a prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu, odabrani kandidat će dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata ili ovjerene preslike. Kandidati koji se zapošljavaju u reguliranoj profesiji u sustavu odgoja i obrazovanja u Republici Hrvatskoj, a kvalifikaciju su stekli izvan Republike Hrvatske, ne mogu se zaposliti u odgojno-obrazovnoj ustanovi temeljem rješenja o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije koje izdaje Agencija za znanost i visoko obrazovanje, već temeljem rješenja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koje izdaje Ministarstvo znanosti, obrazovanja i mladih. Osobe kojima je rješenjem Ministarstva znanosti, obrazovanja i mladih priznata inozemna stručna kvalifikacija kojom se ostvaruje pravo na pristup i obavljanje regulirane profesije nisu dužne ishoditi rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje za potrebe zapošljavanja u odgojno-obrazovnoj ustanovi.(više na poveznici: https://mzom.gov.hr/odgoj-i-obrazovanje/priznavanje-inozemnih-strucnih-kvalifikacija-regulirane-profesije/priznavanje-inozemnih-strucnih-kvalifikacija-za-obavljanje-reguliranih-profesija-u-republici-hrvatskoj/3196). Kandidatom u natječajnom postupku smatra se osoba koja je podnijela urednu, pravovremenu i potpisanu prijavu na natječaj zajedno sa svim prilozima te koja ispunjava uvjete iz natječaja. Nepotpune, neuredne te nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Srednja škola Dental centar Marušić obrađuje osobne podatke kandidata prijavljenih na natječaj u skladu s Općom uredbom o zaštiti podataka (EU) 2016/679 u svrhu popunjavanja radnog mjesta za koje je raspisan javni natječaj. Rok prijave na natječaj je 8 dana od dana objave na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje odnosno na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči škole. Prijavu s potrebnom dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostaviti na adresu Srednja škola Dental centar Marušić, Benkovačka 10a, 21000 Split, s naznakom „Za natječaj“. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem ostavljene adrese elektroničke pošte.
