jobs.title: Hitsaaja-asentaja Lohjalle
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme Jamenet Oy:lle hitsaaja-asentajaa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Lohjalle. **Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja monipuolista hitsaaja-asentajaa, joka viihtyy vaihtelevissa työtehtävissä** teollisuuden kunnossapidon parissa ja haluaa päästä tekemään **koneiden ja laitteiden hitsaus-, korjaus-, asennus- ja kunnossapitotöitä konepajaympäristössä.**

Korjattavana ja huollettavana on monenlaisia teollisuuden koneita ja laitteita, kuten stabilointikoneita, kahmareita ja muita työkoneita. Työt vaihtelevat pienemmistä komponenteista hyvinkin raskaisiin koneisiin. Kokemus esimerkiksi myös pumppujen parissa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi. **Toivommekin, että sinulla on kokemusta erilaisista teollisuuden kunnossapidon tehtävistä ja hitsausosaamisesi on hyvällä tasolla.** Luokkahitsari yrityksestä löytyy valmiina, joten luokkia sinulla ei tarvitse olla suoritettuna.

Jamenet Oy toimii Lohjan Muijalan teollisuusalueella yhdessä Sideko Oy:n kanssa. Yrityksessä tehdään monipuolisesti koneistus-, hitsaus-, asennus- ja kunnossapitotöitä. Työyhteisö on huumorintajuinen noin 15 hengen pieni ja mutkaton tiimi, jossa työntekijät ovat viihtyneet pitkään.

**Työt alkavat nopealla aikataululla heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.** Työtä tehdään yhdessä vuorossa maanantaista perjantaihin ja aloitus on liukuvasti klo 6-7 välillä. Työpäivän pituus on 8,5h sisältäen palkattoman 30 minuutin ruokatauon. Onhan sinulla oma auto liikkumista varten.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään:

**Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat tilanteen mukaan. Pääset tekemään muun muassa**

- Asennushitsausta

- Korjaushitsausta

- Koneiden ja laitteiden korjaus- ja asennustöitä

- Pajalle tuotujen koneiden ja komponenttien kunnostamista

- Teollisuuden kunnossapitotöitä

- Koneenosien ja rakenteiden korjaamista ja kokoonpanoa


Toivomme sinulta:

- Aiempaa työkokemusta hitsauksesta sekä teollisuuden kunnossapidon asennus- ja korjaustehtävistä

- MIG/MAG-hitsauksen osaamista

- Kokemusta asennus- ja korjaustöistä

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- Valmiutta tehdä monipuolisia konepaja- ja kunnossapitotöitä

- Oma-aloitteista ja huolellista työotetta

- Halua oppia uutta

- Hyvää suomen kielen osaamista

- Omaa autoa


**Kone- ja tuotantotekniikan koulutus on eduksi, mutta käytännön työkokemus on tärkeintä.**

**Tulityö- ja työturvallisuuskorteista ei ole haittaa, mutta niitä ei edellytetä oman verstaan työtehtävissä. Myöskään erillisiä luokkahitsauspätevyyksiä ei vaadita – tärkeintä on, että hitsaus onnistuu käytännössä.**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Pitkäaikaisen työpaikan monipuolisten teollisuuden kunnossapidon tehtävien parissa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja oppia uusia työmenetelmiä

- Työvaatteet ja henkilönsuojaimet työnantajan puolesta

- Palkkauksen osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, noin 14–24 €/h, Teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimukseen pohjautuen.


Laita hakemuksesi tulemaan pikaisesti järjestelmän kautta ja lähde mukaan hitsauksen ja asennuksen pariin Jamenetin porukaan! Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Tarvittaessa voit kysyä lisätietoa sähköpostitse Timanttien Hannalta hanna.kiertonen@timantti.net.

_Timantti Henkilöstöpalvelut auttaa osaajia löytämään työn, joka sopii heidän taitoihinsa ja tavoitteisiinsa. Työllistämme työntekijöitä eri toimialojen monipuolisiin tehtäviin – niin määräaikaisiin, vakituisiin kuin projektiluonteisiinkin työsuhteisiin. Meille työntekijä ei ole vain resurssi, vaan tärkeä osa Timantin yhteisöä. Tarjoamme joustavia ratkaisuja, uusia mahdollisuuksia ja tukea työurasi eri vaiheissa – jotta sinä voit keskittyä siihen, missä olet parhaimmillasi._

jobs.title: Geospatial AI Developer
jobs.description:
**Joensuu preferred | Hybrid/remote within Finland possible | Full-time or part-time alongside studies**

Forest Key is looking for a **Geospatial AI Developer** to strengthen our capacity to develop AI-based solutions for forestry.

We work at the intersection of forestry, remote sensing, GIS, data analytics and software development. The role supports our growing international project portfolio and the development of customer-specific digital solutions for operational forestry.

**Your role**

Your main task will be to develop **AI-based remote-sensing and GIS data-processing solutions for forestry applications**.

The emphasis is on technical development, analytical workflows and robust code rather than polished user-interface development.

Your work may include:

- developing AI and machine-learning solutions using remote-sensing, GIS and forestry data;

- processing and analysing satellite, LiDAR, drone and other large geospatial datasets;

- developing Python-based workflows and maintainable processing pipelines;

- implementing solutions in cloud or other scalable computing environments; and

- supporting technical demonstrations, customer discussions and solution development.


**What we are looking for**

You do not need to be a senior specialist. We are interested in someone with relevant practical experience, strong technical skills and the ability to develop toward independent responsibility.

We expect:

- strong **Python** programming skills;

- practical experience with **AI or machine learning**;

- experience with **remote sensing, GIS and LiDAR or point-cloud data**;

- relevant experience or understanding of the **forest sector and forestry applications**;

- ability to develop analytical work into repeatable and maintainable technical solutions;

- ability to work independently and solve complex technical problems; and

- professional proficiency in **English**.


Professional proficiency in Finnish is a clear advantage.

**Additional advantages**

Experience with one or more of the following is beneficial:

- deep learning, computer vision or advanced point-cloud processing;

- Azure or another cloud environment, Docker or related deployment technologies;

- spatial databases or geospatial software development;

- technical customer meetings and demonstrations; or

- other languages relevant to international work.


Occasional participation in customer visits, conferences or international project activities may be possible.

**What we offer**

You will join a small and growing team where your work has a direct influence on the technical solutions we develop.

The role offers opportunities to:

- work on real operational forestry problems;

- combine AI, software development, GIS and remote sensing;

- participate in Finnish and international projects;

- contribute to new digital forestry services; and

- take increasing technical responsibility as your experience develops.


**Location and working arrangements**

Our office is in **Joensuu**, and the possibility to work regularly from Joensuu is a clear advantage. Hybrid and remote working arrangements within Finland are possible.

The position can be **full-time**, but working hours can also be adapted for a suitable candidate who is completing studies.

For administrative reasons, we are currently looking for a person who is resident and able to work in Finland.

**How to apply**

Please send your **CV** and a short description of:

- your relevant experience;

- the types of AI, remote-sensing, GIS or software-development work you have done; and

- why you would like to join Forest Key.


Send your application to:

Alain Minguet Director of International Business +358 44 9025317 alain@forestkey.eu

For questions about the position, you may contact Alain by email or by phone during the following available periods:

- 28 August, 09:00–11:00

- 2 September, 14:00–17:00

jobs.title: Estimator Brisbane
jobs.description:
About McNab

McNab is one of the largest Construction, Development and Property groups in Australia, with turnover now exceeding $1bn each year. Despite our growth and size, we've never lost our small company DNA - which centres around genuine care for our staff, customers and all our stakeholders. Success for us isn't about awards or growth, it's when we deliver so well that our customers are proud to wear a McNab T-Shirt on weekends!


About the Role

Due to growth our Brisbane team is seeking an Estimator who will support the preparation of cost plans, tenders and pricing for repeat work, ECI opportunities and hard dollar tenders. We genuinely care. We make it easy. We deliver certainty.

This is our promise - to our clients, and everyone we deal with. Delivering on these three things really, really well is what drives us at McNab. Everything we do, from recruiting and training to performance and promotion, centres around this promise.

We leverage the entire McNab Group to deliver certainty for our clients at a time of unprecedented uncertainty in the industry. And our approach works. From delivering our own property developments, to manufacturing our own building products, and a plethora of aligned businesses, your career at McNab goes well beyond traditional construction roles.


McNab benefits:

  • Annual health and fitness subsidy.

This is an outstanding opportunity to build a strong career with a reputable construction company that genuinely cares about the development of all staff - if this is something you want to be a part of APPLY NOW!

jobs.title: Barnehagelærer
jobs.description:
Vi lyser ut et vikariat som barnehagelærer med tiltredelse snarest og varighet til 18.06.27. Med mulighet for forlengelse.

Vi søker etter deg som er ambisiøs på vegne av barna, handlekraftig, omsetter teori til praksis, og som virkelig ønsker å skape en god barnehage til det beste for barnet og familien!  

Svanevågen søker Barnehagelærer vikariat – og kanskje er det deg?

Vi leter etter en trygg medarbeider som vet hvor stor forskjell én god relasjon kan gjøre. En som har hjertet på rett sted, hodet fullt av fag, og som drives av å gjøre barnas verden rikere – gjennom omsorg, utforsking og engasjement. Som vi sier i våre verdier: En som er kompetent og nyskapende med et stort hjerte til det beste for barnet.

Hva kan du forvente hos oss? Du får bli en del av et lag med høy faglig puls og et stort hjerte. Vi gir deg:

Et varmt og inkluderende kollegafellesskap

  • Veiledning og faglig utvikling fra første dag

  • Et arbeidsmiljø som tar forskning på alvor og setter kunnskap ut i livet

  • Nettverk med 3000 Norlandia

  • Kolleger over hele landet

  • Anstendig lønn og pensjon og eget fordelsprogram

  • Ekstra støtte til nyutdannede

  • En hverdag fylt med variasjon, lek og ekte øyeblikk

Vi tror du lykkes hos oss hvis du:

  • Brenner for å skape trygge relasjoner og god barndom

  • Liker å være tilgjengelig for barna, responsiv og deltakende

  • Villig til å omsette pedagogisk teori til praksis bygget på systematikk

  • Ser betydningen av kvalitet og omsetter observasjon og refleksjon over egen praksis til trening og handling

  • Støtter barns lek og læring med sensitivitet og varme

  • Bidrar til et alderstilpasset pedagogisk innhold med fokus på tidlig stimulering, lek og læring

  • Faglig engasjert, profesjonell og setter barnets beste først

Hvem er vi i Norlandia Barnehagene?

Vi er en barnehagekjede som tør å tenke nytt. Vi jobber systematisk med kvalitet, og bruker CLASS som verktøy for å styrke relasjonen mellom barn og voksne. Vi er kunnskapsdrevne, varme og opptatt av at alle barn – uansett bakgrunn – skal få en barndom preget av mestring, trygghet og glede.

Formelle kvalifikasjonskrav

• Treårig høgskoleutdanning som barnehagelærer eller annen treårig pedagogisk utdanning på høgskolenivå med videreutdanning i barnehagepedagogikk

• Godkjent utdanning fra Utdanningsdirektoratet.

• Utenlandske søkere må ha Bergenstest/B2 og godkjent utdanning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse - https://hkdir.no/utdanning-frautlandet

• Godkjent politiattest (ikke eldre enn 3 måneder) må vises ved tiltredelse (ref. barnehageloven §30)

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli intervjuet fortløpende, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at stillingen kan bli besatt før annonsen utløper.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Norlandia Barnehagene er vårt mål er at alle barn skal ha et likeverdig tilbud og gå i en høykvalitetsbarnehage. Nøkkelen til det er kompetente ansatte som er omsorgsfulle og utviklingsorienterte, derfor deler vi kunnskap med hverandre og er stolte av arbeidsplassen vår.

Vi baserer vårt arbeid på kunnskap og innovasjon, som omhandler at vår praksis utvikler seg i tråd med ny forskning og erfaring. God ledelse, felles kultur og standard, samt et rikt leke- og læringsmiljø er viktig for barna, og for oss.

Derfor har vi valgt ut noen felles satsningsområder som vi vet har stor betydning for barns utvikling og progresjon. Vi jobber helthetlig og systematisk med intern kompetanseutvikling og ekstern barnehagevurdering med blant annet CLASS som verktøy.

jobs.title: Klar til et lagerjob med fart på – og mulighed for fastansættelse?
jobs.description:
Måske har du allerede et job. Men er det også det job, du har lyst til at blive i?

Hvis du har erfaring fra lager, er vant til at arbejde i et godt tempo og gerne vil have en arbejdsdag, hvor du bruger kroppen, arbejder sammen med andre og kan se, hvad du får fra hånden, så har vi en spændende mulighed i Kolding.

FLAIR søger medarbejdere til en større virksomhed i Kolding, hvor der er godt gang i lageret – og hvor der for de rette medarbejdere er mulighed for fastansættelse.

En arbejdsdag, der ikke foregår bag et skrivebord

Her bliver du en del af den daglige logistik og sørger sammen med dine kolleger for, at varerne kommer sikkert og effektivt gennem lageret.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Kørsel med el-stabler

  • Scanning og registrering af varer

  • Læsning og losning

  • Håndtering af paller og gods

  • Forskellige praktiske lageropgaver

Har du erfaring med el-stabler, er det et stort plus.

Har du samtidig truckcertifikat, er det endnu bedre – men det er ikke et krav.

Erfaring og den rigtige indstilling tæller

Du behøver ikke have den lange uddannelse eller det perfekte CV.

Måske arbejder du allerede på lager og er klar til at prøve noget nyt. Måske har du tidligere arbejdet med logistik, produktion eller varehåndtering og savner en mere aktiv hverdag.

For os er det vigtigere, at du:

  • Møder til tiden og tager dit arbejde seriøst

  • Kan lide, når der er tempo på

  • Arbejder effektivt og præcist

  • Er tryg ved at arbejde med scanner og digitale hjælpemidler

  • Har lyst til at være en del af et team, hvor alle bidrager

  • Taler dansk eller kan kommunikere godt på engelsk

Morgenmenneske eller natteravn?

Ikke alle ønsker et klassisk 8-16-job – og her har du flere muligheder.

Der er job på:

Daghold
Eftermiddags-/aftenhold
Nat-/morgenhold

Så uanset om du helst vil have fri om eftermiddagen, sove længe eller trives bedst om natten, kan der være et skift, der passer til din hverdag.

Mere end bare det næste vikariat

Stillingen starter som gennem FLAIR, men ambitionen er klar:

Finder du og virksomheden det rigtige match, er der mulighed for fastansættelse.

Du får grundig oplæring, gode kolleger og en arbejdsplads med en uformel omgangstone, hvor der er fart på og fokus på at få tingene gjort ordentligt.

Kolding
Opstart efter aftale

Skal du lige se, hvad der ellers findes?

Du behøver ikke være aktivt jobsøgende for at være nysgerrig.

Har du erfaring fra lager – og især med el-stabler – så send os dit CV.

Måske bliver det dit næste job.

jobs.description:
Barona hakee asiakasyrityksensä Ramirentin konevuokraamoon tekevän tyypin, jolta onnistuu yhtä hyvin pieni muotoiset koneiden huoltotyöt kuin sujuva asiakaspalvelu vuokraamossa. Työ on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa, ja pääset käyttämään sekä käsiä että päätä..

Mitä työ pitää sisällään

- Palautuvan vuokrakaluston laskenta ja palautustarkastus
- Pienet huolto- ja korjaustyöt, esim. peräkärryn takavalon vaihto tai moottorisahan terän vaihto
- Kaluston varastointi ja järjestyksen ylläpito
- Kaluston vienti ja nouto työmailta (pikku E-kortti vaaditaan)
- Satunnaisesti vuokraamon tiskillä: asiakaspalvelua ja kaluston luovutusta
Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä vuokraamoesimiehen ja muun vuokraamon henkilökunnan kanssa - tiimissä on sinut mukaan lukien neljä henkilöä.

Toivomme sinulta

- Kädentaitoja huoltohommiin
- Asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja itseohjautuvaa otetta
- Kohtuullisia IT-taitoja
- Sujuva suomi, englanti kohtuullisella tasolla
Mitä tarjoamme

- Vakaan työpaikan tiiviissä tiimissä, jossa esimies on lähellä
- Työsopimus solmitaan alkuun Baronan kanssa määräaikaisena
- Selkeät työajat arkisin klo 07.00-16.30 välillä
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukainen palkkaus
Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, ja töiden aloitus sovitaan heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemus Baronan rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta, ja sinuun ollaan yhteydessä, jos etenet ensimmäiseen haastatteluun.

jobs.title: Director of Strategy, Communications and Impact
jobs.employer: THE ASSOCIATION FOR THE EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES TRANSPARENCY INITIATIVE (EITI)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Founded on the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) brings together governments, civil society and companies to improve natural resource governance. With over 50 member countries and 60 supporting companies, the EITI promotes transparency, accountability and informed policymaking in the extractive sector. 

Behind this ambitious and impactful organisation is a diverse and dynamic team of experts working together to advance the EITI mission. Based in Oslo, Norway, the EITI International Secretariat comprises a collaborative, multinational and multilingual team of around 50 professionals who value growth and development, strong relationships, open dialogue and inclusive leadership.

Who you are

As a senior leader, the Director of Strategy, Communications and Impact will play an important role in shaping the organisation’s strategic direction, strengthening collaboration across teams and supporting the culture of trust, accountability and high performance.  The role includes leading multiple workstreams and teams across the Secretariat.

This position brings together strategy development, strategic communications, monitoring, evaluation, learning and impact. Reporting to the Executive Director, the role will work closely with the Board Chair and Senior Management Team to strengthen EITI’s external influence and evidence-based impact narrative.

As a member of the Senior Management Team, the successful applicant will contribute to organisational decision-making, planning, delivery and finance.

The EITI International Secretariat’s values are Integrity, Professionalism and Respect for Diversity. The successful applicant will identify with and demonstrate behaviours consistent with these values. Personal suitability for the position, including alignment with the EITI values, will be a decisive factor in the selection process. 


Duties and responsibilities
  • Coordinate strategy development and provide strategic updates to the Board and Senior Management Team.
  • Embed strategic priorities in resourcing, work planning and impact measurement.
  • Coordinate updates to the Secretariat’s risk matrix and mitigating actions.
  • Provide strategic leadership for EITI communications channels and outputs.
  • Oversee implementation of the EITI communications strategy.
  • Lead development of high-level speeches, media engagement, crisis communications and statements.
  • Ensure quality assurance across blogs, news, newsletters and flagship publications.
  • Support effective communication of Board decisions by the Chair and Executive Director.
  • Oversee MEL, KPIs, results frameworks and evidence gathering to demonstrate impact.
  • Identify opportunities to increase visibility of EITI outcomes, through targeted communication materials.  
  • Contribute actively to Senior Management Team discussions on strategy, delivery, finance and organisational priorities.
  • Management and oversight of Communication and MEL work streams.
Qualifications
  • Senior leadership experience in complex international organisations.
  • Proven experience in strategy development, communications and MEL.
  • Ability to translate strategic priorities into organisational action and delivery.
  • Strong judgement in managing competing priorities, complexity and organisational risk.
  • Track record of leading communications in an international organisation.
  • Strong understanding of media networks and strategic use of social media.
  • Experience with engaging senior stakeholders across government, industry, civil society and development partners.
  • Ability to represent an organisation in complex multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong people leadership skills, with a commitment to inclusion, accountability and collaboration.
  • First-hand knowledge and senior-level experience of working in low- and middle-income countries in the non-profit sector. 
  • Strong commitment to the pursuit of transparency, accountability, and good governance in the extractive sector globally. 
  • A first degree in a relevant social science subject or related discipline. A post-graduate qualification is desirable.
  • Fluency in English. Competence in one or more of the official languages of the EITI is desirable.
We can offer

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a multi-stakeholder organisation driving positive global change.

Located in central Oslo, the EITI International Secretariat offers hybrid work options, an attractive benefits and above-market pension and insurance package. See information about the benefits we offer here.

The Secretariat can offer employment in Norway based on the Norwegian salary structure. Indicative gross salary benchmarking suggests an annual range starting at 1,120,000 NOK. Placement within the senior leadership salary range will be determined in accordance with the organisation’s internal salary policy. The final offer will be determined based on factors including the labour market, role requirements, internal equity, budget, work location, and the successful candidate’s experience and skills.

Our preference is for this role to be based in Oslo, alongside other members of the Senior Management Team. Exceptional candidates may also be considered on a remote-working basis, provided that their location does not prevent them from fully engaging in the day-to-day work of the Secretariat and travelling to Oslo when required by organisational needs. Relocation support may be provided in accordance with the Secretariat’s internal relocation policy.

Email applications will not be processed.

ContactsMark Robinson, Executive Director
LocationRådhusgata 26
0151 Oslo
Key information:Employer: Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI)

Reference number: 5165108197
Percentage of full-time: 100%
Permanent position
Application deadline: 09/09/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) is the global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources.

Guided by the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the EITI has established a global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources. The EITI Standard requires the disclosure of information along the extractive industry value chain from the point of extraction, to how revenues make their way through the government, and how they benefit the public. By doing so, the EITI seeks to strengthen public and corporate governance, promote understanding of natural resource management, and provide the data to inform reforms for greater transparency and accountability in the extractives sector. In each of the 55 implementing countries, the EITI is supported by a coalition of government, companies, and civil society.

The EITI is committed to achieving diversity in terms of gender, nationality, culture and educational background. The EITI is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Helt om natta, og helt om dagen!
jobs.description:
Trives du i en aktiv hverdag med mye utfordringer og variasjon i arbeidet? Setter du sikkerhet og folka først? 

Vi i Ramudden ser nå etter flinke trafikkmedarbeidere som kan hjelpe oss å vokse videre å møte etterspørselen fra våre kunder i tiden fremover.

Vi bistår våre kunder med alt innenfor trafikksikkerhet, og du vil få mulighet til å være tett på både små og store vei-, vedlikeholds- og byggeprosjekter i hele Innlandet fylke. 

Typiske oppgaver kan være:

  • Trafikkdirigering
  • Ledebilkjøring
  • Forvarslingsvogn
  • Transportoppdrag
  • Montering av midlertidig sikring
  • Skilting

Vi har også monteringsoppdrag tilknyttet bygg, anlegg, tunneldrift og ulike vakt- og beredskapsoppdrag. Vi er også ofte involvert i større publikumsarrangementer i området, så her er det stor variasjon og ingen dag er lik! 

Vi er en sammensatt gjeng med ulik bakgrunn og utdanning, og har ingen konkrete krav til deg som søker utover at du tar sikkerhet på alvor, og forholder deg til gjeldende regler og lovverk som sikrer at alle kommer trygt hjem hver dag. En jobb hos oss er for mange et viktig samfunnsoppdrag, hvor du må være bevisst ansvaret og rollen du har når det kommer til sikkerheten på norske veier. Vi lærer deg alt du trenger å kunne, men den gode holdningen og profesjonelle atferden, den har du med deg i sekken fra før av. 

Eksempler på ulike bakgrunner du har kan være fra:

  • Kundeservice
  • Logistikk
  • Bygg & anlegg
  • Drift og vedlikehold
  • Undervisning
  • Praktisk og/eller teknisk bakgrunn
  • Andre fagområder

Er du pensjonist og har lyst til å være aktiv, sosial og en del av Ramuddenlaget, så søk gjerne hos oss!

Kompetansekrav:

  • Førerkort klasse B som minimum. BE og gjerne klasse C, men det er ikke et krav
  • Bestå AVK 1 og 3 (ikke som krav før ansettelse, men du må bestå dette for å kunne jobbe ute på veien) 
  • Av sikkerhetsårsaker og dokumentasjonskrav, må du kunne kommunisere godt på norsk muntlig og skriftlig 
  • Benytte telefon og ulike digitale systemer i din arbeidshverdag

Som person er du forhåpentligvis; 

  • en med godt humør som smitter over på både kunder og kolleger
  • teknisk og praktisk anlagt
  • en som trives med å omgås og kommunisere med andre mennesker
  • en god lagspiller som vil bidra til et godt og trygt arbeidsmiljø
  • strukturert og nøye, og kan tilfredsstille høye krav til dokumentasjon av arbeidet
  • fokusert på arbeid, og forstår viktigheten av å sette sikkerheten foran alt annet 
  • generelt god helse og fysikk som tillater deg å stå/gå/løfte utstyr

Vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter tariff
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø og gode kollegaer som har det morsomt sammen på jobb 
  • Gode videreutviklingsmuligheter internt i Ramudden lokalt og nasjonalt 
  • Fleksibilitet i rollen, dette passer deg som lever et liv hvor du ikke er avhengig av å jobbe 8-16
  • 30-60 % stilling 

 

Vi skal ansette opptil 10 nye kolleger, og håper at den ene er deg! 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE SUMMARY

As a Social Media Support Specialist, you are at the forefront of helping developers create while managing our social media presence and community interactions. You'll assist developers with complex technical issues, billing inquiries, account management, and product usage questions across multiple channels including X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, Apple/Google Play stores, and other relevant platforms.

You will help bubble up what is important to Replit's engineering and Product teams, and what needs improvement to your own team, while also serving as a key voice in our social media community engagement.

We use tools like Zendesk, Sprout Social, Linear, Slack, Stripe, Orb, Notion, and Replit itself to get the job done, alongside social media management platforms for X, LinkedIn, and Reddit.

You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.

 



IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets and social media accounts to solve account, billing, and product issues

 - Manage and respond to customer inquiries and community discussions on X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, and Apple/Google Play stores, with the possibility of expanding coverage to additional platforms as we grow

 - Monitor social media channels for product feedback, technical issues, and community sentiment

 - Manage escalations from social media channels and coordinate with appropriate internal teams to ensure timely resolution

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit

 - 4+ years of social media support experience, across platforms including on X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Reddit, and Apple/Google Play stores

 - Experience with support platforms (Zendesk, Sprout Social), payment systems (Stripe, Orb), and ticketing workflows

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong written communication skills for public-facing social media interactions

 - Comfort operating with autonomy and ambiguity

 - Ability to maintain brand voice and tone all channels

 - Strong understanding of each social platform’s distinct audience and etiquette

 - Understanding of developer communities and technical terminology

 


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with community management or developer relations

 - Background in B2B SaaS customer success or support

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)

AEO/GEO/SEO Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Search is being rebuilt in real time. Millions of people now start with a question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity, and the answer they get decides which products they try. When someone asks how to build an app, a website, or a tool for their business, Replit needs to be the answer.

We're hiring an AEO/GEO/SEO Lead to own how Replit gets discovered, across AI-generated answers and traditional search. This is a zero-to-one role. You'll define the strategy, then execute it yourself with AI-leveraged production, agency partners, and cross-functional teams behind you. You'll work daily with our Web, Growth, Brand, Content, Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

The fastest-growing AI-native companies have already turned AI answers into a primary acquisition channel. Your mandate is to do the same for Replit: grow AI referral traffic into one of our largest sources of new builders, keep our traditional search presence compounding, and make Replit the platform AI assistants recommend when anyone wants to build software.

Replit moves fast. We ship continuously, experiment relentlessly, and aim to make every builder more productive and creative. We're looking for someone who thrives in that environment: part strategist, part operator, part scientist of a channel that changes every month.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the AEO/GEO Strategy Define where Replit must show up across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, for which prompts and buyer intents, and build the playbook to win those answers. Set targets, sequence the roadmap, and defend the strategy with data.

 - Win Citations Across the Open Web LLMs cite what they trust: Reddit threads, YouTube videos, high-authority publications, community content, and well-structured owned pages. Build durable programs on each of these surfaces, understand the half-life of an AI citation, and keep Replit ranked as models retrain and retrieval systems shift.

 - Run SEO End to End Own keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and content-driven organic growth in partnership with our Head of Web. Protect and grow search equity through a major site relaunch, and coordinate with our paid search team on keyword coverage.

 - Build the Content Engine Produce and direct content designed for two readers at once: LLM crawlers and humans. Blogs, comparison pages, videos, and structured resources, created at volume with AI-assisted workflows and held to a high quality bar. The durable human work here is judgment: strategy, editorial quality, and distribution.

 - Stand Up Measurement Build reporting for a channel that lacks perfect attribution: AI referral traffic, share of voice in AI answers, citation tracking, and downstream signups and revenue. Run controlled experiments, isolate what actually moves citations, and teach the rest of the company what you learn.

 - Direct Agencies and Tools Own our agency and vendor relationships across search and AI visibility, plus the tool stack that powers tracking and production. Write the briefs, hold the quality bar, and decide what stays in-house.
   



YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years in SEO, organic growth, or content-driven acquisition (ideally within SaaS, technology, or developer-focused businesses), including hands-on AEO/GEO work within the last year

 - Can show real results: AI referral traffic you grew, citations you won, rankings you moved, and how you measured all of it

 - Are technically fluent in SEO: keyword research, crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture, and log analysis

 - Understand how LLMs actually retrieve and cite sources, and how that differs across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

 - Write clearly and quickly, and can direct people, agencies, and AI tools to produce content that earns citations

 - Are analytical enough to build credible measurement in a messy, fast-changing channel, connecting organic visibility to traffic, signups, product adoption, and revenue

 - Are comfortable partnering with engineering, product, content, and analytics stakeholders to get changes shipped in a fast-moving environment

 - Love building from scratch: frameworks, processes, and strategy

 - Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, and don't wait for someone else to define the playbook

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach and willingness to dig into the details
   



BONUS POINTS:

 - Made AI answers a primary acquisition channel at a PLG, consumer, or developer-facing software company

 - Deep Reddit fluency: you understand how communities work and how to earn credible presence there

 - Experience running YouTube as an organic discovery channel

 - Hands-on with AI visibility and citation tracking tools (Profound, Peec, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or similar)

 - Programmatic SEO at meaningful scale

 - You've built with Replit or other AI building tools and understand our builders firsthand

 - Experience directing SEO/AEO agencies and fractional specialists

Luxembourg OR Amsterdam, Netherlands
Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm OR 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
Hybrid

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst – Audit to support and enhance the organization's security posture across multiple jurisdictions. This role is responsible for executing audit activities, strengthening compliance frameworks, and aligning security strategies across both legacy and modern technology environments. The candidate will work closely with audit partners and internal stakeholders to ensure adherence to audit and regulatory requirements and continuous improvement of security assurance practices.

The ideal candidate has at least four years of experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, risk management, or compliance. This role ensures adherence to global regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, GDPR, ISO), evaluates control effectiveness, and serves as a primary liaison for auditors. The role requires strong risk assessment capabilities, proactive issue resolution, and a balanced focus on compliance and enterprise resilience in tandem with security leadership.

Some of the things that you will be doing:

• Partner with global teams across business operations, compliance, IT, and legal to manage technology risk and regulatory compliance.
• Plan and execute internal, external, and jurisdictional audits in line with the audit roadmap.
• Develop and enhance security policies, standards, procedures, and compliance frameworks.
• Improve IT compliance processes and identify automation opportunities for control activities.
• Design and execute control testing strategies and ensure proper evidence documentation.
• Maintain and enhance control frameworks aligned with regulatory and industry standards.
• Conduct IT risk assessments and track remediation of identified gaps.
• Coordinate with auditors, regulators, and stakeholders during audit cycles.
• Track and report compliance metrics and program effectiveness indicators.
• Leverage GRC tools for audit management, evidence tracking, and reporting.
• Identify risks and vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.
• Manage third-party/vendor risk assessments and escalations.
• Respond to regulatory and jurisdictional audit requests.
• Provide actionable insights and reporting to security leadership.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• 4+ years of experience in IT audit, risk management, or cybersecurity.
• Strong knowledge of Global regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, ISO, DORA PCI, PSD2 and NIST.
• Familiarity with audit standards and frameworks (SOC 1 & 2, ISO 27001, NIST, COSO, COBIT).
• Understanding of cybersecurity threat landscape and control environments.
• Knowledge of modern technologies including cloud, DevOps, application security, and AI.
• Experience working with/ customizing GRC tools (e.g., Archer, OneTrust, AuditBoard, Diligent).
• Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive approach towards available work requests and timely response.
• Ability to translate technical risks into business insights.
• Hands-on experience in IT disciplines and audit execution.

• Ability to manage complex compliance requirements across jurisdictions.
• Strong organizational and proactive risk management skills.
• High integrity, accountability, and professional excellence.
• CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CIA, or other relevant cybersecurity, audit, or risk certifications.

jobs.title: HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


CDD, full-time, ref: [HTIPC26]
Service: National Business Relationship Management
Hierarchical Superior: Director, Business Relationship Management



About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.

Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.


Job mission:


Department description:

The Business Relationship Management division builds and maintains strategic relationships with Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. Within this division, the HealthTech team supports the development and competitiveness of Luxembourg's health technologies sector — spanning medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation — by connecting companies to relevant programmes, research organisations and European initiatives.


Job description:

As a HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator, you will drive the operational management and strategic coordination of healthtech-related projects at national and European level. You will coordinate the activities of the HealthTech team members, ensuring that project milestones are delivered on time and within budget, while fostering collaboration between internal colleagues, consortium partners, research organisations and Luxembourg-based companies across the health technologies value chain.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.


Main tasks and responsibilities:

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:


Inspire:

Monitor technological, regulatory and market developments across the healthtech landscape (medtech, digital health, biotech, pharma) and translate insights into actionable opportunities for the ecosystem
Contribute to the design and implementation of Luxinnovation's HealthTech strategy and annual work programme, aligned with national health innovation priorities
Represent Luxinnovation in healthtech-related fora, conferences and working groups at national and European level
Promote Luxembourg's healthtech ecosystem and its competitive advantages to international partners and stakeholders


Assess & Accelerate:

Manage the operational delivery of healthtech innovation projects, ensuring alignment with consortium work plans, KPIs and budgets
Coordinate the contributions of the HealthTech team members across active projects, ensuring clarity of roles, coherent planning and timely delivery of individual and collective workstreams
Track project progress through regular reporting (CRM, European project management systems), flag risks and propose corrective actions
Identify companies' innovation needs within the healthtech sector and assess their potential to participate in collaborative R&D projects
Support companies in navigating regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (e.g., EU Medical Device Regulation, European Health Data Space)


Connect:

Serve as the central coordination point within the HealthTech team, facilitating information flow, aligning priorities and ensuring synergies between team members' respective activities and project portfolios
Coordinate with consortium partners, research organisations and institutional stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution and knowledge exchange
Facilitate matchmaking between Luxembourg healthtech companies and international partners for collaborative innovation projects
Act as an internal interface, connecting healthtech project activities with other Luxinnovation services (funding, market intelligence, digitalisation)
Develop and maintain professional relationships across the national and European healthtech ecosystem


Fund:

Support Luxembourg companies in accessing European healthtech funding programmes (Horizon Europe Health Cluster, EIT Health, Innovative Health Initiative, Digital Europe Programme)
Ensure compliant budget tracking, timesheet management and financial reporting for all projects under your coordination
Identify synergies between national RDI funding instruments and European healthtech calls to maximise funding opportunities for ecosystem actors
Contribute to the preparation and submission of new collaborative project proposals in the healthtech domain


This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.


Required competencies:

Education level and professional experience required:

University degree at Master's level (Bac+4/5) in life sciences, biomedical engineering, health economics, public health, business management or equivalent
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in project coordination or management within the healthtech, life sciences or health innovation sector
Proven experience managing multi-partner collaborative projects (national or European)
Experience coordinating small cross-functional teams or workgroups
Knowledge of European R&D programme structures (Horizon Europe, EIT Health, IHI) is a strong asset
Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA) is desirable


Specific competencies:

Solid understanding of the health technologies landscape, including medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation
Proven ability to manage complex project portfolios with multiple workstreams, partners and deadlines
Strong team coordination skills, with the ability to align diverse contributors around shared objectives and delivery timelines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical health innovation challenges into structured project plans
Excellent stakeholder engagement and diplomatic skills across institutional, academic and private-sector actors
Knowledge of Luxembourg's socio-economic environment and health innovation ecosystem is an asset
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (EU MDR, IVDR, European Health Data Space) is an advantage


Languages:

Fluent English and French are mandatory (oral and written, minimum C1 level)
German and/or Luxembourgish is considered an asset


IT Skills:

MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and MS Project or equivalent
CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics)
European project management platforms (e.g., EC Funding & Tenders Portal, JEMS)
Knowledge of collaboration and reporting tools (Teams, SharePoint)


Why choose this position?

This role places you at the intersection of health innovation, European R&D policy and team leadership. You will coordinate a dedicated team of healthtech specialists while managing high-impact projects that accelerate the adoption of health technologies in Luxembourg. Join a collaborative environment where your expertise in project coordination and your passion for healthtech will contribute directly to strengthening Luxembourg's position as a competitive player in the European health innovation landscape.


Application:

Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us! [...]

jobs.title: Regional General Manager, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




WHO WE ARE:

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for Germany, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

 - Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

 - Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to German customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

 - Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion.

 - Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across Germany.

 - Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

 - Make agentic transformation central to the German GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

 - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

 - Build “sell with” partner motions in Germany, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning.

 - Establish Notion as a visible force in the German ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

 - Represent the voice of German customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

 - Create a talent destination in Germany by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

 - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in Germany and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent.

You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow.

You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in Germany.

 - Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams.

 - Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics.

 - Deep knowledge of the German enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics.

 - Experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment.

 - Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products.

 - Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes.

 - Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process.

 - Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative.

 - Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product.

 - Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building.

 - Fluency in German and English.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model.

 - Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes.

 - Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation.

- Remote, GermanyEmployees can work remotely
- Full-time

Company Description

English

We are Nagarro – a global SAP Business Unit with a strong focus on digital transformation. We design and implement innovative IT solutions that drive businesses forward across industries. With more than 1,200 SAP experts in Germany and 18,000 colleagues worldwide, we offer a dynamic, open, and team-oriented work environment.

We advise our clients on IT strategies, implement and operate SAP systems, and develop tailored solutions for SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA. Our expertise spans retail, manufacturing, process industries, professional services, and the public sector. We work in on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments and develop in-house products to increase efficiency.

Wir sind Nagarro – eine globale SAP Business Unit mit starkem Fokus auf digitale Transformation. Wir gestalten und implementieren innovative IT-Lösungen, die Unternehmen branchenübergreifend voranbringen. Mit mehr als 1.200 SAP Expert:innen in Deutschland und 18.000 Kolleg:innen weltweit bieten wir ein dynamisches, offenes und teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir beraten unsere Kunden zu IT Strategien, implementieren und betreiben SAP Systeme und entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für SAP ERP und SAP S/4HANA. Unsere Expertise reicht von Handel über Fertigung und Prozessindustrie bis zu Professional Services und dem öffentlichen Sektor. Wir arbeiten in On-Prem-, Cloud- und Hybrid-Umgebungen und entwickeln eigene Produkte zur Effizienzsteigerung.

Job Description

English

As an SAP PSCD Consultant, you will:

- Take responsibility for customer projects in SAP Public Sector Management (PSM) and support the PSCD module.
- Lead or assist in all project phases: conception, design, customizing, prototyping, and roll-out of SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA solutions.
- Analyze, optimize, and improve processes in public sector finance.
- Ensure functional and technical feasibility of SAP solutions.
- Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to deliver high-quality SAP services.
- Contribute to knowledge transfer and best practices within the SAP team.

Deutsch

Als SAP PSCD Consultant übernimmst du:

- Verantwortung für Kundenprojekte im SAP Public Sector Management (PSM) und Unterstützung des PSCD-Moduls.
- Betreuung aller Projektphasen: Konzeption, Design, Customizing, Prototyping und Roll-out von SAP ERP- und SAP S/4HANA-Lösungen.
- Analyse, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen im Public Sector Finance.
- Sicherstellung der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzbarkeit von SAP-Lösungen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und internen Teams, um hochwertige SAP-Services bereitzustellen.
- Mitwirkung beim Wissensaustausch und der Weitergabe von Best Practices innerhalb des SAP-Teams.

Qualifications

English

- Completed degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, or equivalent qualification with relevant professional experience
- Proven experience in SAP consulting, ideally in SAP PSM and PSCD modules
- Solid knowledge of Public Sector Management (PSM) processes and SAP PSCD

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

Warum KettenWulf?

Vom Sauerland in die Welt - wir bei KettenWulf sind ein internationales Team, das gemeinsam über alle Ebenen zielorientiert am Erfolg arbeitet. Als mittelständisches Familienunternehmen in der vierten Generation sind wir ein sicherer Arbeitgeber und bieten Raum für individuelle Entwicklung.

Was machen wir?

KettenWulf produziert schon bereits seit 100 Jahren Förderketten, Antriebsketten und Kettenräder für die unterschiedlichsten Branchen und gehört zu den führenden Markenherstellern. Besonders die Qualität unserer Produkte liegt uns am Herzen.

Unsere Arbeitskultur:

Kurze Dienstwege, transparente Prozesse und flache Hierarchien sowie eine offene und ehrliche Umgangsweise miteinander zeichnet das KettenWulf Team aus. Zahlreiche Benefits wie die betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Bike-Leasing sowie regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents unterstreichen die große Wertschätzung gegenüber unseren Mitarbeitenden.

Ihre Aufgabenschwerpunkte

- Pflege und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen in den Ländern Spanien und Portugal

Experience with food processing and packaging equipment from manufacturers such as Weber, MULTIVAC, K+G Wetter and VEMAG is a strong advantage

Ability to troubleshoot mechanical and technical problems independently
Electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic experience is an advantage
Good spoken and written English is required
Reliable, organized and able to work both independently and as part of a team

Opportunity to work with a wide range of modern food processing and packaging machinery

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Benelux
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 

This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

The client’s mission is to cut the cost of modern AI by co-designing hardware, software, algorithms, and models — with the goal of making AI’s benefits accessible to society. They’re active contributors to open-source AI research and are looking for researchers and engineers to help build the next generation of AI infrastructure.Cooperation: This starts as contract work via our platform. jobs.title: Network & Client Management, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a relationship builder with a passion for driving growth? Management Events is seeking Key Client Managers and Network Growth Managers to join our team. You will play a pivotal role in expanding our network of high-level decision-makers. How do these roles contribute to the company's growth?

As a Key Client Manager, you will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with existing C-suite clients.

As a Network Growth Manager, you will identify and cultivate new relationships with C-suite executives.

In this role, you will:

    Identify and engage with high-level decision-makers in your target market market
    Initiate contact with C-level Executives by phone and on LinkedIn to excite them about our concept
    Demonstrate the value of our service and convince them to become part of our exclusive business network in personal scheduled videocall meetings
    Build strong, long-term relationships with C-level executives
    Learn more about their interests, investments plans and upcoming projects
    Develop and execute strategies to expand our network and build valuable relationships, by knowing your customers key challenges and focus areas
    Contribute to the overall growth and success of Management Events

What We’re Looking For

    Previous experience with cold calling and building business relationships
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
    Strong business acumen and a results-oriented mindset
    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
    Passion for connecting with key industry players and driving business growth
    Proactive and persistent approach to reaching new clients and overcoming challenges
    Fluency in Danish and English

What We Offer

That’s why you can earn up to 12 extra vacation days each year and enjoy local perks such as gym and massage discounts, along with other wellness benefits. Curious about the details in your location? That’s why we love bringing people together through company trips, international events, and local office celebrations — whether it’s hitting the slopes in Levi, running the Berlin Marathon together, or celebrating milestones across our offices in Europe.
    Annual company trip: Every summer, all employees from our different offices come together in Finland for an exciting company trip - a mix of team building, knowledge exchange, and celebrations.
    Global Community & Diversity: Diversity is part of our DNA. With colleagues from over 50 nationalities, you’ll join an international community where every culture, perspective, and background fuels innovation and success.

Recruitment Process

    Screening video call with our Recruitment Team.
    First interview with the Hiring Manager.
    Second interview (including a short role-play) with the Team Manager.
    Reference check and/or short personal assessment

Please submit your CV in English.

jobs.title: Customer Support Associate with Norwegian & English – Sofia, Bulgaria
jobs.description:
For more than 37 years, Sutherland has been a global leader in Customer Experience Management (CXM). As a pioneer in automation and innovative customer solutions, we deliver exceptional service on behalf of our clients worldwide.

With operations in 60 countries and a presence in Bulgaria since 2008, our diverse team of more than 2,000 professionals supports customers in 17 different languages from Sofia, Varna, Burgas, and remote locations.

🎯 About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate with Danish and English to join our team supporting customers of a leading international telecommunications provider.

You will assist customers through inbound voice and non-voice channels, including phone, email, and chat, with day-to-day service-related questions such as top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general account inquiries. This is a pure customer service role with no sales, upselling, or device troubleshooting.

    Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other supported channels
    Assist customers with top-ups, SIM activation, roaming usage, and general service-related questions
    Resolve customer concerns efficiently and aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible
    Accurately document customer interactions and follow established processes
    Provide professional, clear, and empathetic support in every interaction

🧠 What We’re Looking For

Must-have:

    Norwegian – minimum B2 level
    English – minimum B2 level
    Undergraduate, graduate, postgraduate education or equivalent
    Strong verbal and written communication skills
    Good computer skills and ability to work with multiple systems
    Availability to work 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday

Nice-to-have:

    Previous experience in customer service, BPO, telecommunications, or a similar environment
    Experience working with CRM or ticketing systems
    Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindset

🎁 What You’ll Get

Compensation & Benefits:

    Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
    Additional health insurance
    Food vouchers
    3 weeks of paid training in English, followed by accreditation
    Relocation support to Sofia for eligible candidates

Work Environment:

    Onsite from our Sofia office
    Working hours: 09:00–18:00, Monday to Friday
    Voice and non-voice customer support

Growth & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing support while developing your customer service and communication skills in an international environment.

🚀 Ready to Apply?

Join us and become part of a team that delivers exceptional customer experiences every day. Apply now and start your journey with Sutherland.
